docs.title: MioROM
docs.text:
> MIOROM // RE_FRAMEWORK_v1.0.4 Modular Low-Level Binary & Assembly Primitives for Console ROM Hacking NDS ARM9/ARM7/THUMB N64 MIPS-VR4300 GBA ARM7TDMI WII BROADWAY PPC PS1 MIPS-R3000A SNES W65C816 NES MOS-6502 SEGA M68000 GB SM83 TESTS: 1520+ PASSED RUNTIME DEPS: ZERO (STDLIB ONLY) DISASSEMBLER: 8 ARCHITECTURES LICENSE: MIT

MioROM is an advanced Python framework and low-level primitive library designed for ROM hacking, game localization engineering, and binary reverse engineering.

Rather than imposing a monolithic graphical interface or rigid one-click workflows, MioROM delivers foundational programmatic building blocks: declarative struct modeling, progressive streaming scanners, micro-assembly emitters, and multi-architecture SSA IR decompilers. Developers assemble these primitives directly into bespoke, reproducible extraction, translation, and repacking toolchains.

docs.title: 1. Declarative Binary Struct Modeling (BinaryStruct)
docs.text:
Stop writing brittle manual struct.unpack_from("<IIH", data, offset). Define binary structures cleanly with typed fields, dynamic lengths, bitfields, and automated validation:

from miorom.core.schema import BinaryStruct, FixedString, U16, U32, EnumField, ParseError
from enum import IntEnum

class CompressionType(IntEnum):
    NONE = 0x00
    LZ10 = 0x10
    LZ11 = 0x11
    YAZ0 = 0x20

class RomHeader(BinaryStruct):
    _endian = "<"
    magic = FixedString(4, default="ROM1")
    version = U16(default=1, validate=lambda v: v >= 1)
    compression = EnumField(U16(), CompressionType)
    file_count = U32()

# Unpack from raw binary bytes
header = RomHeader.from_bytes(raw_bytes)
print(header.magic)        # "ROM1"
print(header.compression)  # CompressionType.LZ11

# Modify and serialize back
header.version = 2
packed_bytes = header.to_bytes()

docs.title: 2. Multi-Architecture SSA IR Decompilation (BinaryLifter)
docs.text:
Lift raw machine code from PowerPC, ARM32, MIPS32 (including COP1 floats), SM83, and M68K into an architecture-neutral Static Single Assignment (SSA) Micro-IR, and decompile directly into readable C pseudocode:

from miorom.script.lifter import BinaryLifter

# MIPS machine code snippet (e.g. from N64 or PS1)
mips_bytes = bytes.fromhex("2404002A 8C820000 03E00008 00000000")

# Lift to SSA Intermediate Representation
ir = BinaryLifter.lift(mips_bytes, base_address=0x80001000, arch="mips", endian=">")

# Generate human-readable C pseudocode
c_code = BinaryLifter.decompile_to_c(ir)
print(c_code)
# Output:
# int sub_80001000() {
#     int $a0_1, $v0_1;
# loc_80001000:
#     $a0_1 = 0x2A;
#     $v0_1 = *($a0_1);
#     return $v0_1;
# }

docs.title: 3. Fast3D Texture Codecs & Display List Parsing
docs.text:
Extract and inject N64 Fast3D graphics textures (RGBA32, RGBA16, IA16, I8, CI8) directly into transparent PNGs, or parse microcode commands straight from display lists:

from miorom.graphics import N64TextureDecoder, N64TextureEncoder, Fast3DParser

# Decode raw N64 RGBA32 binary bytes to PNG
N64TextureDecoder.to_png(raw_bytes, fmt="rgba32", width=32, height=32, output_path="icon.png")

# Re-encode edited PNG back to native N64 binary bytes
n64_binary = N64TextureEncoder.from_image("icon_edited.png", fmt="rgba32")

# Parse display list microcode stream (G_SETTIMG, G_SETTILE, G_SETTILESIZE)
textures = Fast3DParser.find_textures(display_list_bytes)
for tex in textures:
    print(f"Discovered {tex.format_name} ({tex.width}x{tex.height}) at 0x{tex.image_ptr:08X}")

docs.title: 4. Dialogue Localization & Clean Script Catalogs
docs.text:
Extract complex dialogue with variable-width fonts, sanitize pointer artifacts, and export clean human-readable scripts formatted in [id]\ntext:

from miorom.formats.script_catalog import DialogueCleaner, ScriptCatalog

# Strip binary pointer noise, raw hex tags, and format clean newlines
clean_text = DialogueCleaner.clean("<1A><13>-<08>You found the <05>AFairy Bow<05>@!<01>Shoot it with B.")
print(clean_text)
# Output:
# You found the AFairy Bow@!
# Shoot it with B.

# Dump translation rows to plain human-readable [id] script file
ScriptCatalog.dump_script("script.txt", translation_rows, clean=True)

# Synchronize edited script back into CSV translation columns
ScriptCatalog.script_to_csv("script_translated.txt", "base.csv", "updated.csv")

docs.title: 5. Fan Translation Reverse Engineering Toolkit
docs.text: Surgical primitives for dissecting and translating retro game ROMs: - JapaneseCharMapMiner: Gojūon relative search engine auto-generating draft .tbl character tables from raw ROM binaries. - FontDissector: Heuristic font scanner, VWF width table hunter, and PNG spritesheet round-trip pipeline. - TextCompressionHunter: Retro Huffman tree graph walker and DTE bigram forensic scanner with optimal re-compressor. - ScriptVMDissector: Event script bytecode disassembler and branch relinker recalculating all jump targets automatically. - TilemapDissector: Menu nametable text scanner, ASCII layout visualizer, and translated graphic label splicer. - VWFHookEngine: End-to-end VWF hook deployer across ARM32, Thumb, MIPS32, SNES 65816, and MOS 6502 with automatic code cave allocation.

docs.title: Installation
docs.text:
Install MioROM from PyPI:

pip install miorom

Or install the latest development tree directly from GitHub:

pip install git+https://github.com/MiokoTech/miorom

docs.title: 1. Core & Memory Management (miorom.core)
docs.text: Class / Function Description MioRomResult Serialization contract for public result objects (to_dict(), from_dict(), JSON round-trip). BinaryReader Big-endian / little-endian binary stream reader with safe seeking and padding. BinaryWriter Stream serializer with alignment support and patch generation. BitReader Arbitrary bitstream reader supporting MSB-first and LSB-first bit ordering across byte boundaries (read_bits(), read_signed_bits(), peek_bits(), skip_bits(), align_byte()). BitWriter Arbitrary bitstream writer supporting MSB/LSB accumulation, signed integers, and byte padding (write_bits(), write_signed_bits(), align_byte(), to_bytes()). SNESBusMapper Pure mathematical 24-bit SNES bus address and ROM file offset mapper for LoROM (Mode 20), HiROM (Mode 21), and SMC headers. NESBusMapper Pure mathematical bus-to-offset mapper for NES NROM (16KB/32KB), MMC1, and MMC3 8KB PRG banking (Modes 0 and 1). GameBoyBusMapper Cartridge ROM file offset mapper for Game Boy Bank 0 and switchable banks with MBC1 translation quirks. RetroChecksum Pure-Python retro checksum algorithms: CRC-16 (CCITT, XMODEM, ARC, Modbus), pure IEEE 802.3 CRC32, Adler-32, Fletcher-16, Genesis 16-bit word sum, SNES complement pair, and Game Boy header/global checksums. VariableLengthIntCodec Codec for MIDI 7-bit continuation VLQ, unsigned/signed LEB128, SQLite 1-9 byte varint, and ZigZag encoding. Shortcuts: encode_vlq(), decode_vlq(), encode_uleb128(), decode_uleb128(), encode_sleb128(), decode_sleb128(). rol, ror, bit_reverse Pure-Python bitwise rotation (rol/ror), bit reversal (bit_reverse8/16/32), and nibble packing/swapping (swap_nibbles, pack_nibbles, unpack_nibbles). sign_extend, popcount, clz, ctz, bswap Immediate integer sign extension, population count (popcount), count leading zeros (clz), count trailing zeros (ctz), and word byte swaps (bswap16/32/64). CanonicalHuffmanTable, HuffmanNode Canonical Huffman tree builder and bit-level table encoder/decoder. Implements build_huffman_tree(), extract_code_lengths(), generate_canonical_codes(), and direct stream encoding/decoding via BitReader / BitWriter. BinarySlicer, find_free_blocks Zero-copy memoryview slice navigator (BinarySlicer), chunking stream (chunk_bytes), alignment boundary calculators (align_up, align_down, pad_bytes), and contiguous padding/code-cave block discovery (find_free_blocks). RingBuffer, LzssMatchFinder High-performance sliding window circular buffer (RingBuffer) with RLE overlapping copy support (copy_lz_match), and hash-chained longest-match finder (LzssMatchFinder) with window expiration pruning for proprietary LZ compression algorithms. calculate_entropy, sliding_entropy_scan Shannon entropy calculator (0.0 to 8.0 bits/byte), byte frequency histogram, Chi-squared randomness testing, and sliding-window scanner to discover embedded compressed/encrypted stream boundaries (find_entropy_regions). xor_bytes, rolling_xor, add_cipher Byte-level deobfuscation suite: multi-byte repeating XOR (xor_bytes), rolling-key stream cipher (rolling_xor), bitwise NOT (invert_bytes), Caesar byte-addition (add_cipher), and automated single-byte XOR key cracker (crack_single_byte_xor). combine_split_words, deinterleave_channels Split-bus memory reconstruction: merges separate low-byte, high-byte, and bank-byte arrays into 16/24-bit words (combine_split_words, split_words); demuxes and interleaves multi-channel byte streams (deinterleave_channels, interleave_channels). cumulative_offsets, delta_decode Pointer and table offset resolvers: converts length sequences into contiguous start offsets (cumulative_offsets, offsets_to_lengths), differential delta encoders/decoders (delta_encode, delta_decode), and base relative-to-absolute translations. PointerTableCandidate, find_pointer_tables Pointer table sequence & monotonic stride validator: unpacks/packs 16-bit, 24-bit, and 32-bit pointer words (unpack_pointer, pack_pointer, unpack_pointers, pack_pointers), verifies monotonic ordering (verify_stride_monotonicity, calculate_monotonicity_ratio), evaluates statistical metrics & confidence (analyze_pointer_sequence), remaps addresses (remap_pointers), and discovers candidate tables in raw binaries (find_pointer_tables). BankedPointer, SplitPointerTable Split-bank & dual-table far pointer relinker: resolves (bank, address) to/from ROM file offsets (resolve_banked_to_offset, resolve_offset_to_banked), reads/writes parallel dual tables (read_split_pointer_table, write_split_pointer_table) and 3-byte contiguous far arrays (read_interleaved_pointer_table, write_interleaved_pointer_table), and performs in-place banked table relocations (relocate_banked_table). PointerTable Absolute, relative, and flagged pointer table manager with 1:1 relocation. PointerEntry Individual pointer abstraction with value, offset, and target tracking. SegmentTable Registry of hardware and virtual segment base addresses (N64 0x00..0x0F, PS1 KSEG0, SNES banks). SegmentedAddressResolver Two-way resolver translating segmented virtual addresses (e.g. 0x07001234) to/from physical offsets. StringScanner Automatic text detector for UTF-8, Shift-JIS, UTF-16, and ASCII. StringScanner.iter_strings() Progressive string generator for itertools pipelines and early exit. PointerScanner Heuristic pointer table scanner pointing to discovered string blocks. PointerScanner.iter_pointer_tables() Progressive pointer-table generator for streaming scans. ByteOffsetMapper LCS-based 1:1 byte alignment mapper for expanded strings. RelocatableBuffer Pristine snapshotting memory buffer for safe chained patch commits. MemoryMap Segmented emulator and hardware address space mapper. SignatureScanner IDA/Ghidra-style wildcard byte pattern matcher ("E1 A0 00 00 ?? ?? ?? 1A"). BinaryStruct Declarative struct schema modeling (U8, U16, U32, FixedString, Array). BinaryStruct.sizeof_dynamic() Measures dynamic variable-length structs (PascalString, SentinelArray, If) from binary bytes. BinaryStruct.offset_of_dynamic() Resolves dynamic field offsets directly from bytes with structured ParseError on truncation. CStructOverlay Interactive ANSI C / C99 struct layout parser compiling C code directly into binary byte layouts. CStructInstance Dynamic record instance with dot/dict access, serialization (to_dict(), to_json()), and pack capabilities. CField Field descriptor with byte offset, size, type name, array length, and nested struct support. SchemaField(validate=...) Declarative validation hook enforcing logical field boundaries during parsing. MultiLevelPointerTable Hierarchical cascading pointer table dereferencer (Chapter -> Scene -> String). TableLevel Specification for a single level in a multi-level pointer table. RecordBuilder Fluent binary record and struct constructor with padding, strings, and alignment. BitField, BitFieldCodec Sub-byte bitfield and packed record codec: defines arbitrary bit-width schemas (1 to 64 bits), signed two's complement fields, MSB/LSB bit ordering, in-place buffer mutation (pack_into()), and tabular array processing (unpack_all()). SymbolMap Address and symbol notebook with No$GBA (.sym) and Ghidra CSV export/import. SymbolMap.to_ghidra_script() Exports symbol table as a runnable Ghidra Python Script. SymbolMap.to_ida_idc() Exports symbol table as an IDA Pro IDC script. SymbolMap.to_sym() Exports symbol table in standard No$GBA / PCSX emulator format. SymbolEntry Data record representing an annotated memory address symbol. HexDiffHighlighter Visual terminal diff renderer highlighting binary changes with ANSI color codes.

docs.title: 2. Disassembly, Assembly & Static Analysis (miorom.asm)
docs.text: Class / Function Description UniversalDisassembler Multi-arch disassembler for 8 architectures: PowerPC, ARM32, Thumb-16, MIPS I-IV / COP1, Game Boy (SM83), Motorola 68000, MOS 6502 (NES), and W65C816 (SNES with dynamic REP/SEP tracking). DisasmInstruction Decoded instruction object with mnemonic, operands, branch target, and raw bytes. SymbolicXrefEngine Cross-architecture static analyzer discovering symbolic cross-references (ARM, Thumb, PPC, MIPS, W65C816, MOS6502). XRefDatabase Bidirectional index of code and data cross-references (xrefs_to(), xrefs_from(), callers_of(), annotate_disassembly()). XRefRecord Rich cross-reference link with source/target addresses, symbols, and instruction metadata. FunctionPrologueScanner Automated function boundary detector using preamble bitmasks (addiu $sp, push {lr}, push {r4-r7, lr}, stwu r1, php; rep #$xx; pha). CodeDataDisambiguator Separates CODE, JUMP_TABLE, RODATA, STRING, and PADDING deterministically. DataFlowSlicer Backward program slicer resolving switch-case jump tables and indirect branches. JumpTable Reconstructed switch-case jump table with case targets. AsmSnippet Factory for fluent micro-assembly snippet emission: .arm(), .thumb(), .mips(), .ppc(), .sm83(), .snes(). ArmSnippet Fluent ARM32 instruction sequence builder (push, pop, mov, add, sub, b, bl, bx, nop). ThumbSnippet Fluent 16-bit ARM Thumb instruction sequence builder for GBA & NDS (push, pop, mov, add, sub, cmp, ldr, str, b, b_cond, bl, bx, blx, nop). MipsSnippet Fluent MIPS instruction sequence builder (lui, addiu, li, lw, sw, jr_ra, j, jal, nop). PpcSnippet Fluent PowerPC 32-bit instruction sequence builder for GC & Wii (stwu, lwz, stw, addi, li, lis, ori, mr, mflr, mtlr, b, bl, blr, nop). SM83Snippet Fluent Game Boy SM83 instruction sequence builder (ld, push, pop, call, ret, jr, jp, cb, rst). SnesSnippet Fluent W65C816 instruction sequence builder for SNES (rep, sep, clc, sec, pha, pla, lda, sta, ldx, stx, ldy, sty, jsr, jsl, rts, rtl, bra). CodeCaveFinder Scans executables for contiguous unused padding bytes (0x00/0xFF). CodeCaveManager Tracking and allocation registry for ROM free-space blocks with automated candidate scanning. ArmHookBuilder Pure bitwise instruction builder for ARM BL/B, Thumb BL (4-byte), Thumb B, and return trampolines. HookManager Coordinates inline hook placement at call sites and trampoline assembly in target code caves. M68kDisassembler Motorola 68000 instruction disassembler covering data, arithmetic, branch, and control opcodes. M68kInstruction Decoded M68K instruction record with size, branch targets, call identification, and listing formatting. calc_arm_branch, calc_thumb_branch Low-level mathematical branch opcode calculators and resolvers for 32-bit ARM (B, BL with 8-byte prefetch pipeline compensation) and 16-bit Thumb (dual-hword BL/BLX pair with 4-byte pipeline compensation). calc_mips_jump, calc_mips_branch, calc_6502_branch Target calculation primitives for MIPS 26-bit pseudo-absolute jumps (J, JAL), MIPS 16-bit word-offset branches with delay slot calculation, and MOS 6502 / W65C816 8-bit signed relative branches. BranchRelocator, BranchRelocation PC-relative branch displacement rebasing engine for MOS 6502, W65C816, Z80, SM83, M68K, ARM, Thumb, and MIPS; recalculates relative jumps when relocating routines to code caves and discriminates internal vs external branch destinations (rebase_block(), patch_single_branch()). TrampolineHook Generates multi-architecture trampoline hooks (MIPS, ARM, Thumb, MOS 6502, W65C816 SNES JML/JSL) preserving original opcodes. VWFHookConfig Declarative configuration for VWF hook deployment: architecture, hook ROM/RAM addresses, original instruction bytes, glyph width table source, optional explicit cave address, fallback width, character range, and endianness. VWFDeploymentReport Full audit trail of a VWF hook deployment: hook record, table ROM/RAM offset and size, lookup routine ROM/RAM offset and size, total code cave bytes consumed, and verification status (to_dict() for logging). VWFHookEngine End-to-end VWF hook orchestrator: verifies hook site integrity (verify_hook_site()), generates architecture-specific width lookup routines (synthesize_width_routine() for ARM32, Thumb, MIPS32, SNES W65C816, MOS 6502), and atomically deploys width table + trampoline into a ROM code cave (deploy() with simulate=True dry-run mode). PPCInstructionScanner Finds paired lis + addi split pointers in PowerPC Wii/GameCube binaries. MIPSInstructionScanner Finds paired lui + addiu split pointers in MIPS PS1/N64 binaries. CheatCodeGenerator Generates Gecko, Action Replay, CWCheat, and GameShark memory patch codes. AntiPiracyBypasser Scans and patches NDS cartridge checks, checksum loops, and PPC integrity branches.

docs.title: 3. Intermediate Representation & Scripting (miorom.script)
docs.text: Class / Function Description BinaryLifter Lifts machine code instructions into compiler Micro-IR and decompiles to pseudo-C. IRFunction, IRBlock, IRInstruction SSA-form Intermediate Representation primitives. ScriptVM Declarative cutscene/event bytecode virtual machine (disassembler & assembler). MioScriptCompiler High-level script DSL compiler with structured if-else, loops, and function calls. ScriptArcheologist Inferred opcode signatures from raw bytecode streams to synthesize working VMs. ScriptDecompiler Reconstructs high-level AST (IfStmt, WhileStmt) from linear bytecode. ScriptAST, ScriptASTBuilder Abstract Syntax Tree engine for dialogue and cutscene scripts. ScriptExtractor Bidirectional ROM script extraction and reinserter supporting TXT/CSV serialization and dry-run validation. ExtractionResult, ExtractedEntry Structured container holding extracted script entries, offsets, raw bytes, and control code tags. InsertionReport Diagnostic summary of script reinsertion with inserted counts and overflow warnings. detect_delimiters, detect_control_codes Script delimiter & control code auto-detector: discovers 1-byte/multi-byte string terminators across pointer boundaries (detect_delimiters), identifies embedded bytecode opcodes and estimates parameter arguments (detect_control_codes), generates ScriptBoundaryReport (analyze_script_boundaries), and extracts cleanly bounded script entries (slice_script_entries). DialogueDissector, DialogueBlock Automated ROM dialogue pointer table scanner and extractor: maps console base addresses, extracts dialogue blocks to GNU gettext .po or JSON, and reinjects translated text with automatic free-space relocation (scan_dialogue_tables(), reinject_dialogues()). VMOpcodeType Enumeration of VM instruction categories: TEXT, BRANCH_REL, BRANCH_ABS, SWITCH, CONTROL, and TERMINATOR. VMInstructionDef Opcode schema definition carrying opcode byte, mnemonic, type, fixed length, text terminator, length-prefix flag, declarative schema (SchemaField / BinaryStruct), and legacy operand format string. DissectedInstruction Fully decoded script instruction: index, ROM offset, byte length, opcode, raw bytes, text payload, branch target, relative delta, switch targets, and operand offset. DissectedScriptVM Disassembled script container with instruction list and base offset; provides get_dialogues() for dialogue extraction and to_po() for GNU gettext PO export. ScriptVMDissector Linear sweep bytecode disassembler for arbitrary opcode schemas (disassemble()); dynamic text replacement and relinking engine that rewrites translated strings and recalculates all relative branch deltas, absolute jump targets, and switch tables in-place using declarative BinaryStruct schemas (splice_and_relink()).

docs.title: 4. Deep Forensics, Cryptanalysis & Synthesis (miorom.scanner, miorom.diff, miorom.archive)
docs.text: Class / Function Description DmaTableArchive High-level abstraction for parsing, querying, extracting, and decompressing N64 DMA filesystems. DmaFileEntry Descriptor for individual DMA files with virtual/physical boundaries and compression status. CryptoScanner Scans for AES S-Boxes, MD5/SHA-1 constants, TEA delta (0x9E3779B9), and CRC32 tables. XRefAnalyzer, XRefGraph Bi-directional cross-reference analyzer with pointer tracing and Mermaid export. BinDiffEngine Compares binaries via CFG graph isomorphism and mnemonic cyclomatic similarity. PatchAuditor Validates IPS/BPS patch hunks against critical ROM memory regions (headers, DMA descriptors, vectors) to prevent asset collision. ArchiveSynthesizer Heuristic reverse-engineering for unknown archives; auto-generates Python parser code. TextStreamScanner, TextStreamSpan Multi-byte Japanese binary text stream scanner: strict lead-byte and trail-byte FSM validation for Shift-JIS, EUC-JP, UTF-16LE, UTF-16BE, and ASCII; filters machine code false positives, computes confidence metrics, and detects contiguous string tables (scan(), scan_string_table()). DeepScanner, InspectionReport Automated container fingerprinting and Shannon entropy profiling.

ElfRelocator Resolves PowerPC, ARM, and MIPS relocations (ADDR32, ADDR16_LO, REL24). DolBinary GameCube / Wii DOL executable header parser and memory segment injector. MioRomHeap Dynamic slab/buddy runtime heap allocator (miorom_malloc, miorom_free). RomLayoutExpander Physical ROM expander for GBA (32MB), NDS, and N64 (64MB) with CIC recalculation. SaveStateDiffHunter Differential memory snapshot fuzzer and multi-level pointer trail discovery. DolphinClient, DolphinMemoryMock Live memory bridge into running Dolphin Emulator via shared memory.

docs.title: 6. Text, Typography & Localization (miorom.text, miorom.helper)
docs.text: Class / Function Description CharMap Custom .tbl character table transcoder for 1-byte, 2-byte, and multi-byte encodings. CharMapMiner Statistical n-gram character matrix miner reconstructing unknown .tbl tables. JapaneseCharmap Multi-byte character encoding handler supporting Shift-JIS and EUC-JP with bidirectional dakuten and handakuten composition/decomposition. TrieTranscoder High-performance greedy longest-prefix transcoder for complex DTE dictionaries. WordWrapper Fixed-width character-count word-wrapper and textbox dimension validator (miorom.text.line_wrapper). PixelWordWrapper True on-screen Variable Width Font (VWF) word-wrapper and boundary checker (miorom.text.line_wrapper). FontMetrics Proportional character glyph width and kerning registry (miorom.text.line_wrapper). VwfLineWrapper, AdaptiveLineWrapper Pixel-accurate VWF word-wrapper and paginator accepting dicts, binary table bytes, callables, FontGlyphInjector, or FontMetrics instances. Preserves game control codes ([wait], {hero}, <color:red>) during line measurement. LineWrapResult, TextBoxPage Structured results containing paginated dialogue pages, per-line pixel widths, and overflow diagnostics. DTEMiner, DTEToken Dual-Tile and Multi-Tile Encoding (DTE/MTE) frequency miner and token dictionary builder (miorom.text.dte). DteOptimizer, DteCodec DTE/MTE n-gram frequency optimizer and greedy two-way transcoder integrated with CharMap for net-savings dictionary compression. DteStats, DteEntry Result dataclasses for dictionary compression metadata (bytes saved, ratio, per-token frequency). TagManager, TagSyntaxValidator Complete markup control tag lifecycle suite: bidirectional code-to-tag conversion, bracket balance verification, and translation variable fidelity checks (miorom.text.tags). TagValidationReport Structured diagnostic report of tag syntax validity, unmatched brackets, and missing game variables. docs.title: Binary & Assembly Primitives
docs.text:
MioROM provides modular, low-level binary manipulation and assembly primitives designed for ROM hacking, localization engineering, and binary reverse engineering.

Rather than imposing monolithic workflows, these primitives act as composable building blocks that you integrate directly into custom extraction, patching, and repacking pipelines.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text: Primitive Module Purpose BinaryReader miorom.core Endian-aware stream reader, zero-allocation static unpacker, and format gateway BinaryWriter miorom.core Fluent binary stream writer, atomic packer, and in-place buffer mutator PatchWriter miorom.patch Fluent binary patching with offset tracking and IPS generation UpsPatcher miorom.patch Universal Patching System (UPS) with XOR diffing and CRC32 BpsPatcher miorom.patch Modern Beat Patching System (BPS) creator and applier AsmSnippet miorom.asm Pure-Python micro-assembler for ARM, Thumb, MIPS, PPC, SM83, and SNES SymbolicXrefEngine miorom.asm Multi-architecture symbolic cross-reference discovery and call graphs CStructOverlay miorom.core Interactive ANSI C struct parser compiling C declarations into binary layouts RecordBuilder miorom.core Fluent binary struct and header serializer with alignment SymbolMap miorom.core Symbol table with No$GBA .sym and Ghidra CSV export HexDiffHighlighter miorom.core Terminal hex diff renderer with ANSI colors GameTextTemplate miorom.text Bidirectional dialogue template engine BMFont miorom.text AngelCode BMFont reader/writer with pure-Python PNG atlas packing

docs.title: 1. Stream I/O & Atomic Packing — BinaryReader & BinaryWriter
docs.text: BinaryReader and BinaryWriter provide fluent, endian-aware stream reading and writing, alongside zero-allocation static unpacking and atomic packing methods.

docs.title: Fluent Streaming I/O
docs.text:
from miorom.core.binary import BinaryReader, BinaryWriter

# Writing binary streams
writer = BinaryWriter(endian=">")
writer.write_u32(0x12345678).write_u16(0xABCD).write_u8(0x42)
writer.write_string("Item_Name", encoding="utf-8", null_terminated=True)
writer.align(4, pad_byte=0x00)
data = writer.to_bytes()

# Reading binary streams
reader = BinaryReader(data, endian=">")
magic = reader.read_u32()
version = reader.read_u16()
flags = reader.read_u8()
name = reader.read_string(encoding="utf-8")

docs.title: Static Zero-Allocation Helpers & Format Gateway
docs.text:
Eliminates repetitive struct.unpack_from and struct.pack boilerplates:

# Atomic unpacking without instantiating BytesIO
magic = BinaryReader.unpack_u32(rom_bytes, offset=0x1C, endian=">")
short_val = BinaryReader.unpack_s16(rom_bytes, offset=0x80, endian="<")
comp, chk = BinaryReader.unpack_from("<HH", rom_bytes, offset=0x7FDC)

# Atomic packing & in-place mutable buffer packing
header_magic = BinaryWriter.pack_u32(0x80371240, endian=">")
BinaryWriter.pack_into_u32(rom_buffer, offset=0x80, val=new_size, endian="<")
BinaryWriter.pack_into(">IH", rom_buffer, offset=0x200, 0xCAFEBABE, 0x1234)

docs.title: 2. Binary Patching — PatchWriter & Patcher Suite
docs.text:
PatchWriter provides a fluent interface for applying surgical modifications to binary buffers with automatic boundary checks, cursor management, and IPS patch emission.

Key methods:

  • write_at(offset, data) — write raw bytes at an absolute offset
  • write_u8_at / write_u16_at / write_u32_at — write typed integers
  • replace_range(start, end, data) — overwrite a contiguous region
  • apply() — return the patched buffer as bytes
  • build_ips() — export the delta as a standard IPS patch file

MioROM also provides native pure-Python patchers: - UpsPatcher: create_file(src, tgt, patch) and apply_file(src, patch, out) using XOR diffing and CRC32 verification. - BpsPatcher: Full BPS v1 spec with source/target copy actions and checksums. - IpsPatcher: Fast 16MB IPS patcher with constant-memory streaming support (apply_stream).

patch_arm9.py
from miorom.patch import PatchWriter, UpsPatcher

rom_data = open("arm9.bin", "rb").read()
writer = PatchWriter(rom_data)

writer.write_at(0x000145A0, b"TRANSLATED_STRING\x00")
writer.write_u32_at(0x00010200, 0x020145A0, endian="<")
writer.replace_range(0x00010300, 0x00010320, b"\x00" * 32)

patched_bytes = writer.apply()

with open("patch.ips", "wb") as f:
    f.write(writer.build_ips())

# Or create a UPS patch directly between files:
UpsPatcher.create_file("source.gba", "modified.gba", "game.ups")

docs.title: 3. Micro-Assembly — AsmSnippet
docs.text:
AsmSnippet generates raw machine code for small function hooks, trampolines, and code caves — no external cross-compiler required (no devkitARM, no GCC).

=== "Thumb (16-bit)"

| Method | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| `push(regs)` / `pop(regs)` | Stack operations (r0-r7, LR/PC) |
| `mov_imm` / `mov_reg` | Load immediate into register / register copy |
| `add_imm` / `sub_imm` | 8-bit or 3-bit arithmetic with immediate |
| `cmp_imm` / `cmp_reg` | Compare register with immediate or register |
| `ldr_imm` / `str_imm` | Load / store 32-bit word relative to register |
| `ldr_pc` / `ldr_sp` | Load literal from PC pool / SP stack |
| `b` / `b_cond` | Relative unconditional or conditional branch |
| `bl` / `bx` / `blx` | 32-bit branch-link, branch-exchange, BLX |
| `nop()` | 16-bit NOP (`mov r8, r8`) |

=== "ARM32"

| Method | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| `push(regs)` / `pop(regs)` | Stack operations |
| `mov_imm(rd, imm)` | Load immediate into register |
| `add_imm` / `sub_imm` | Arithmetic with immediate |
| `b` / `bl` / `bx` | Branch / branch-link / branch-exchange |
| `nop()` | Padding instruction |

=== "PowerPC (PPC32)"

| Method | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| `stwu(rs, offset, ra)` | Store word with update (stack frame setup) |
| `lwz` / `stw` | Load and store 32-bit words |
| `li(rt, imm)` | Load 32-bit immediate (auto splits into `lis + ori`) |
| `mr(ra, rs)` | Move register (`or ra, rs, rs`) |
| `mflr` / `mtlr` | Move from/to Link Register |
| `b` / `bl` / `blr` | Unconditional branch / branch-link / return |
| `nop()` | PowerPC NOP (`ori r0, r0, 0`) |

=== "MIPS"

| Method | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| `lui` / `addiu` / `li` | Upper/lower immediate load (auto split) |
| `lw` / `sw` | Load/store word |
| `j` / `jal` / `jr_ra` | Jump / jump-and-link / return |
| `nop()` | Branch delay slot padding |

=== "SNES (W65C816)"

| Method | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| `rep(flags)` / `sep(flags)` | Reset / Set processor flags (16-bit A/X/Y) |
| `pha` / `pla` / `php` / `plp` | Push and pull accumulator or status |
| `lda_imm` / `lda_addr` / `lda_long` | Load accumulator (8/16-bit, direct, long) |
| `sta_addr` / `sta_long` | Store accumulator |
| `jsr` / `jsl` / `rts` / `rtl` | Subroutine calls and returns (short/long) |
| `nop()` | 65816 NOP (`0xEA`) |

=== "Game Boy (SM83)"

| Method | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| `ld_rr` / `ld_r_n` | Register and immediate loads |
| `call` / `jp` / `jr` / `ret` | Control flow |
| `push` / `pop` | Stack operations |
| `cb(op, reg, bit)` | Bitwise CB prefix operations |
asm_hook.py
from miorom.asm import AsmSnippet

# Thumb 16-bit hook (GBA / NDS)
thumb = AsmSnippet.thumb("<")
thumb.push(["r4", "lr"])
thumb.mov_imm("r0", 42)
thumb.bl(target_vaddr=0x08005200, current_pc=0x08001004)
thumb.pop(["r4", "pc"])
thumb_bytes = thumb.emit()

# PowerPC hook (GameCube / Wii)
ppc = AsmSnippet.ppc(">")
ppc.stwu("r1", -32, "r1")
ppc.mflr("r0")
ppc.stw("r0", 36, "r1")
ppc.li("r3", 0x80245000)
ppc.blr()
ppc_bytes = ppc.emit()

# SNES W65C816 hook
snes = AsmSnippet.snes()
snes.rep(0x20)  # 16-bit Accumulator
snes.lda_imm(0x1234, is_16bit=True)
snes.sta_addr(0x2100)
snes.sep(0x20)  # 8-bit Accumulator
snes.rts()
snes_bytes = snes.emit()

docs.title: 4. Struct Serialization — RecordBuilder
docs.text:
RecordBuilder constructs binary records, file headers, and metadata tables with exact field alignments — without brittle struct.pack format strings.

Supported field types: u8, i8, u16, i16, u32, i32, u64, f32, fixed_str, pascal_str, bytes_field, align

build_item_record.py
from miorom.core import RecordBuilder

record = (
    RecordBuilder(endian="<")
    .u32(0x1001)
    .fixed_str("Herb of Mana", length=16, pad_byte=0x00)
    .pascal_str("Restores 50 HP", length_size=1)
    .u16(50)
    .align(4, pad_byte=0x00)
    .build()
)

Chaining

All builder methods return self, so calls can be chained in a single expression as shown above.

docs.title: 5. Symbol Management — SymbolMap
docs.text:
SymbolMap tracks function entrypoints, jump tables, string pools, and RAM variables — then exports them to debugger and disassembler formats.

Symbol kinds: code, data, table, string

export_symbols.py
from miorom.core import SymbolMap

smap = SymbolMap()
smap.add(0x02001000, "fn_draw_dialogue", kind="code",  comment="Main text renderer")
smap.add(0x02002500, "tbl_dialogue_ptrs", kind="table", comment="Text pointer table")

with open("game.sym", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    f.write(smap.export_sym_file())

with open("ghidra_labels.csv", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    f.write(smap.export_csv())

docs.title: 6. Hex Diff Inspection — HexDiffHighlighter
docs.text:
HexDiffHighlighter renders colorized hex diffs in the terminal — lets you visually verify every changed byte before writing to disk.

verify_patch.py
from miorom.core import HexDiffHighlighter

HexDiffHighlighter.print_diff(
    original=original_bytes,
    modified=patched_bytes,
    offset=0x1000,
    size=64,
    use_color=True,
)

Output format

Modified lines are prefixed with *. Unchanged lines are shown normally for context.

docs.title: 7. Dialogue Templates — GameTextTemplate
docs.text:
GameTextTemplate provides bidirectional parsing for dialogue strings that contain embedded control tags, actor variables, and item parameters.

dialogue_template.py
from miorom.text import GameTextTemplate

tmpl = GameTextTemplate("Hello [HERO:{name}], you received {count}x [ITEM:{item}]!")

rendered = tmpl.render(name="Raguna", count=3, item="Turnip")
# → "Hello [HERO:Raguna], you received 3x [ITEM:Turnip]!"

data = tmpl.extract(rendered)
# → {"name": "Raguna", "count": "3", "item": "Turnip"}

docs.title: 8. C Struct Modeling — CStructOverlay
docs.text:
CStructOverlay parses ANSI C struct declarations and provides a pythonic overlay mapping directly over binary buffers. It supports nested structs, fixed-length arrays/strings, attribute access (monster.hp), dictionary access, table iterations, and in-place binary writes.

parse_c_struct.py
from miorom.core import CStructOverlay

c_decl = """
struct Enemy {
    uint16_t id;
    char name[16];
    int16_t hp;
    int16_t max_hp;
    uint8_t attack;
    uint8_t defense;
    uint32_t exp;
};
"""

overlay = CStructOverlay.from_c(c_decl, endian="<", pack_alignment=1)
print(f"Struct size: {overlay.size} bytes")  # 28 bytes

# Read an entire table of enemies from ROM
enemies = overlay.read_table(rom_data, offset=0x02005000, count=10)
for enemy in enemies:
    print(f"[{enemy.id}] {enemy.name} - HP: {enemy.hp}/{enemy.max_hp}")

# Modify and pack back in-place
enemies[0].hp = 999
overlay.write(rom_data_bytearray, offset=0x02005000, record=enemies[0])

docs.title: 9. Symbolic Cross-References — SymbolicXrefEngine
docs.text:
SymbolicXrefEngine analyzes multi-architecture machine code and pointer structures to discover bidirectional relationships between code and data. It identifies literal pool references, split immediates, direct calls, and jump branches, with IDA/Ghidra-style comment generation.

analyze_xrefs.py
from miorom.asm import SymbolicXrefEngine, UniversalDisassembler

# Scan ARM9 code segment
db = SymbolicXrefEngine.analyze(arm9_bytes, base_address=0x02000000, arch="arm", endian="<")

# Query inbound calls
callers = db.callers_of(0x02004500)
print(f"Functions calling sub_02004500: {[hex(c) for c in callers]}")

# Generate IDA / Ghidra style annotated disassembly
instructions = UniversalDisassembler.disassemble(arm9_bytes[:256], base_address=0x02000000, arch="arm")
annotated_lines = db.annotate_disassembly(instructions)
for line in annotated_lines:
    print(line)

docs.title: 10. AngelCode BMFont & Texture Packing — BMFont
docs.text:
BMFont provides two-way serialization for AngelCode .fnt files (both Text and XML variants), automatic 2D texture atlas shelf packing, and built-in pure-Python PNG encoding/decoding without requiring PIL/Pillow.

bmfont_workflow.py
from miorom.text import BMFont, BitmapFont, PNGCodec

# 1. Load an existing AngelCode font
font = BMFont.from_text(open("dialogue.fnt").read())
print(f"Font: {font.info.face}, Line Height: {font.common.line_height}, Glyphs: {len(font.chars)}")

# 2. Pack a BitmapFont into a 2D atlas texture sheet + pure Python PNG
bf = BitmapFont(default_height=12)
# ... add glyphs ...
bmfont, raw_atlas, png_bytes = BMFont.from_bitmap_font(
    bf, page_file="font_atlas.png", texture_width=256, texture_height=256
)

with open("font_atlas.png", "wb") as f:
    f.write(png_bytes)

with open("font.fnt", "w") as f:
    f.write(bmfont.to_text())

docs.title: Full Pipeline Example
docs.text:
translation_pipeline.py
from miorom.patch import PatchWriter
from miorom.core import RecordBuilder, SymbolMap, HexDiffHighlighter
from miorom.text import GameTextTemplate

# 1. Symbol table
symbols = SymbolMap()
symbols.add(0x00010000, "ptr_table", kind="table", comment="Message pointer table")
symbols.add(0x00018000, "text_pool",  kind="data",  comment="Relocated string pool")

# 2. Render translated dialogue
tmpl = GameTextTemplate("[ACTOR:{actor}] {message}")
translated_lines = [
    tmpl.render(actor="Mist",   message="Good morning! Welcome to the farm."),
    tmpl.render(actor="Raguna", message="Thank you, I will do my best."),
]

# 3. Serialize pointer table + string pool
pool_builder  = RecordBuilder(endian="<")
table_builder = RecordBuilder(endian="<")

current_offset = symbols["text_pool"]
for line in translated_lines:
    table_builder.u32(current_offset)
    encoded = line.encode("utf-8") + b"\x00"
    pool_builder.bytes_field(encoded)
    current_offset += len(encoded)

new_table = table_builder.build()
new_pool  = pool_builder.build()

# 4. Patch ROM
rom_data = open("game_original.bin", "rb").read()
patcher  = PatchWriter(rom_data)
patcher.write_at(symbols["ptr_table"], new_table)
patcher.write_at(symbols["text_pool"],  new_pool)
patched_rom = patcher.apply()

# 5. Audit changes
HexDiffHighlighter.print_diff(
    original=rom_data,
    modified=patched_rom,
    offset=symbols["ptr_table"],
    size=len(new_table),
    use_color=True,
)

# 6. Save output
with open("game_patched.bin", "wb") as f:
    f.write(patched_rom)

docs.title: Changelog
docs.text: All notable changes to MioROM will be documented in this file.

docs.title: Added
docs.text:
• Nintendo Game Boy Advance (GBA) ROM Engine (miorom.platforms.gba.rom / miorom.platforms.gba / miorom.rom.handlers.gba):
  • Implemented analytical parser, builder, header inspector, complement checksum recalculator, cartridge memory capacity manager, backup save detector/patcher, and deep multimedia/sound engine scanner for Game Boy Advance ROM images (GBARom, GBARomHandler, resolve_gba_region, create_synthetic_gba_rom, fix_gba_checksum, GBAHeaderStruct) with 100% zero external dependencies.
  • Implemented declarative 192-byte header binary structure (GBAHeaderStruct) strictly via miorom.core.schema.BinaryStruct ensuring unified binary schema compliance without raw struct calls.
  • Added header complement checksum calculation, validation, and in-place fixing (calculate_header_checksum(), is_header_checksum_valid(), fix_header_checksum()) implementing the hardware-exact complement formula chk = (SUM_{0xA0..0xBC} - 0x19) & 0xFF.
  • Added entry point decoding (entry_point), resolving the 24-bit relative ARM branch opcode at offset 0x00 to physical ARM cartridge space (0x08000000..0x09FFFFFF).
  • Added Nintendo GBA product code regional territory resolver (resolve_gba_region) identifying Japan (J), USA / English (E), Europe (P), Germany (D), France (F), Italy (I), Spain (S), Australia (U), and Worldwide releases from the 4th character of the Game Code.
  • Added cartridge capacity expansion and trimming (expand(), trim()), supporting power-of-two cartridge sizing from 1 MB up to 64 MB with hardware-accurate 0xFF padding (representing erased NOR/NAND flash memory).
  • Added cartridge backup media detection and automated SRAM patching (detect_save_type(), patch_save_to_sram()), identifying EEPROM, SRAM, FLASH512, and FLASH1M signatures and converting backup calls to standard 32KB SRAM for flashcarts and emulators.
  • Added Real-Time Clock (RTC) library signature detection (has_rtc, SIIRTC_V001) integrated directly into detect_save_type() and GBARomHandler metadata.
  • Added Nintendo logo in-place restoration (fix_logo()), restoring the mandatory 156-byte logo bitmap (0x04..0x9F) required by the GBA Boot ROM.
  • Added 32-bit GBA memory pointer operations and surgical relinking (ptr_to_offset(), offset_to_ptr(), find_pointers(), relink_pointers()), enabling seamless translation relocation across Game Pak waitstate spaces (0x08, 0x09, 0x0A, 0x0B, 0x0C, 0x0D).
  • Added direct GBA BIOS software interrupt (SWI) scanner bridge (scan_swi_calls()), resolving embedded calls to BIOS routines (LZ77UnCompWram, CpuSet, RegisterRamReset, etc.).
  • Added deep asset and sound discovery scanners (find_lz10_streams() for Nintendo LZ77 compressed graphics and text streams; find_sappy_songs() integrating with SappyScanner for Music Player 2000 song table candidate discovery).
  • Added synthetic GBA ROM fixture generator (create_synthetic_gba_rom()) supporting custom title, game code, maker code, save types, RTC, LZ10 streams, and Sappy tables for 100% isolated unit testing without copyrighted binaries.
  • Registered GBARomHandler in RomManager with high precedence ahead of generic cartridge fallbacks.
  • Sony PlayStation 1 (PS1 / PS-X) ROM & Disc Engine (miorom.platforms.psx.rom / miorom.platforms.psx / miorom.rom.handlers.psx):
  • Implemented analytical parser, builder, virtual filesystem, SYSTEM.CNF configuration manager, executable manager, multi-media asset scanner, and dual sector serializer for Sony PlayStation 1 disc images (PSXRom, PSXFormat, PSXRomHandler, resolve_psx_region, create_synthetic_psx_iso, create_synthetic_psx_bin, CdSectorHeaderStruct, CdSubHeaderStruct) with 100% zero external dependencies.
  • Implemented declarative low-level CD sector structures (CdSectorHeaderStruct, CdSubHeaderStruct) strictly via miorom.core.schema.BinaryStruct ensuring unified binary schema compliance without raw struct calls.
  • Added dual sector format support: 2048-byte Mode 1 ISO disc images (PSXFormat.ISO) and 2352-byte Mode 2 Form 1 raw CD-ROM sector BIN images (PSXFormat.BIN) with automated sector size detection via ISO PVD magic \x01CD001 at sector 16.
  • Implemented Mode 2 Form 1 CD-ROM sector packaging with sync patterns (SYNC_PATTERN), BCD MSF address calculation (lba_to_msf), subheaders (\x00\x00\x08\x00), and bit-exact 32-bit EDC checksum recalculation (calculate_cdrom_edc) over 2056 bytes per sector.
  • Added SYSTEM.CNF parser and editor (system_cnf, boot_path, game_id, region), resolving boot executables, runtime task control blocks (TCB), event limits (EVENT), and stack pointers (STACK).
  • Added Sony PlayStation 1 product code region resolver (resolve_psx_region) identifying USA (SLUS, SCUS), EUR (SLES, SCES), JPN (SLPS, SLPM, SCPS), and ASIA (SLAJ) regional distribution territories.
  • Implemented virtual filesystem operations (list_files(), has_file(), get_file(), replace_file(), extract_all()) with automated ISO 9660 sector reallocation and extent relocation when injecting enlarged translation assets.
  • Added primary boot executable management (get_main_exe(), replace_main_exe()) interfacing with PSXExe for code/text editing, PC/GP adjustments, and MIPS text modifications.
  • Added deep multi-media discovery scanners (find_textures() for TIM textures, find_audio() for VAG audio streams, find_videos() for STR cutscene movie streams).
  • Added synthetic PS1 ISO and BIN fixture generators (create_synthetic_psx_iso(), create_synthetic_psx_bin()) for 100% isolated unit testing without copyrighted disc images.
  • Registered PSXRomHandler in RomManager with high precedence over generic ISO 9660 handlers.
  • Sony PSP AT3 (ATRAC3 & ATRAC3plus) Audio & Loop Engine (miorom.platforms.psp.at3 / miorom.platforms.psp):
  • Implemented analytical parser, builder, loop point editor, and stream replacer for Sony PlayStation Portable ATRAC3 (0x0270) and ATRAC3plus (0xFFFE extensible GUID) RIFF WAVE audio streams (AT3Audio, AT3Codec, AT3LoopPoint, create_synthetic_at3, RiffHeaderStruct, ChunkHeaderStruct, WaveFormatExStruct, Atrac3FormatExtraStruct, FactChunkStruct, SmplChunkHeaderStruct, SmplLoopEntryStruct) with 100% zero external dependencies.
  • Implemented declarative low-level binary headers strictly via miorom.core.schema.BinaryStruct ensuring unified struct processing without raw struct operations.
  • Added automatic audio codec detection distinguishing ATRAC3 (1024 samples/frame) and ATRAC3plus (2048 samples/frame) with Sony extensible SubFormat GUID verification.
  • Added comprehensive audio metrics inspection (channels, sample_rate, bitrate_kbps, frame_size, total_samples, duration_seconds).
  • Added BGM seamless loop point analysis and modification (is_looped, loop_point, set_loop(), remove_loop()), allowing translators and audio modders to set, adjust, or strip 'smpl' chunks so custom BGM does not stutter, desync, or silence.
  • Added audio payload replacement (replace_data()) with automated sample count recalculation across 'data', 'fact', and 'RIFF' chunk boundaries.
  • Added synthetic AT3 audio fixture generator (create_synthetic_at3()) supporting custom sample rates, channels, frame counts, and loop points for 100% isolated unit tests.
  • Integrated directly into PSPRom (get_boot_audio_at3(), set_boot_audio_at3(), set_boot_audio(), and deep stream scanner find_audio_streams()).
  • Sony PSP PRX Executable & NID Resolver Engine (miorom.platforms.psp.prx / miorom.platforms.psp):
  • Implemented analytical parser, builder, MIPS ELF inspector, bidirectional NID resolver, and MIPS call stub hooker for Sony PlayStation Portable Relocatable Executables (PRXModule, PSPNIDResolver, PRXModuleInfo, PRXImportLibrary, PRXExportLibrary, Elf32HeaderStruct, Elf32SectionHeaderStruct, SceModuleInfoStruct, SceLibraryEntryStruct, SceLibraryStubStruct, create_synthetic_prx) with 100% zero external dependencies.
  • Implemented declarative low-level binary structures strictly via miorom.core.schema.BinaryStruct ensuring unified binary parsing and serialization.
  • Added early encrypted executable detection (b"~PSP" signature) raising informative error guidance directing users to unencrypted PSP_GAME/SYSDIR/BOOT.BIN.
  • Added Sony sceModuleInfo 52-byte descriptor parsing, extracting module name, versions, $gp register initial value, user vs kernel privilege modes, and export/import table boundaries.
  • Implemented dynamic algorithmic SHA-1 32-bit NID hash calculation (calculate_nid()) and offline reverse lookup database mapping ~150+ official Sony SDK function hashes back to human-readable API names across sceDisplay, sceCtrl, sceIo, sceKernel, sceAudio, sceFont, scePower, sceUtility, sceRtc, sceGe, and sceUmd.
  • Implemented MIPS function call stub redirection (redirect_stub()) generating bit-exact MIPS j <target>; nop opcodes for hooking font rendering routines (VWF), filesystem redirection, and game script engines.
  • Added import NID swapping (replace_import_nid()) to redirect dynamic system calls directly within the PRX NID table.
  • Implemented virtual memory address resolution (va_to_offset()) translating section-mapped memory addresses and relocatable base-0 offsets into physical PRX file locations.
  • Added synthetic PRX fixture generator (create_synthetic_prx()) building valid 32-bit Little-Endian MIPS ELF PRX binaries for 100% isolated unit testing without copyrighted binaries.
  • Integrated directly into PSPRom (get_boot_prx(), replace_boot_prx(), get_eboot_prx(), replace_eboot_prx()).
  • Sony PSP Unified Disc & Package ROM Engine (miorom.platforms.psp.rom / miorom.platforms.psp / miorom.rom.handlers.psp):
  • Implemented analytical parser, builder, disc/package virtual filesystem, GUI asset editor, executable manager, and multi-format serializer for Sony PlayStation Portable ROMs (PSPRom, PSPFormat, PSPRomHandler, create_synthetic_psp_iso, create_synthetic_psp_pbp) with 100% zero external dependencies.
  • Added support for all major PSP formats: uncompressed UMD ISO 9660 disc images (PSPFormat.ISO), compressed CSO images (PSPFormat.CSO), and PlayStation EBOOT packages (PSPFormat.PBP).
  • Implemented seamless in-memory and on-disk format cross-conversion (to_bytes(fmt) and save(path, fmt)), enabling lossless ISO <-> CSO <-> PBP transitions.
  • Added comprehensive metadata inspection through embedded PARAM.SFO (sfo, game_id, title, version, category), paired with automatic Sony product code region detection (resolve_psp_region) identifying USA, EUR, JPN, ASIA, KOR, and Global releases.
  • Added XMB/VSH multimedia asset extraction and replacement (icon_bytes, background_bytes, boot_audio_bytes, set_title(), set_icon(), set_background()), enabling ROM translators to customize ICON0.PNG, PIC1.PNG, and SND0.AT3 without manual ISO rebuilding.
  • Implemented high-level virtual filesystem operations (list_files(), has_file(), get_file(), replace_file(), extract_all()) with automated ISO 9660 sector reallocation and extent management when replacing files that exceed their original sector capacity.
  • Added dedicated executable management helpers (get_boot_bin(), get_eboot_bin(), replace_boot_bin(), replace_eboot_bin()) for translation patching of BOOT.BIN and EBOOT.BIN.
  • Added deep texture scanning (find_textures()), traversing disc filesystem paths to identify and parse embedded GIMImage textures.
  • Enhanced CSOImage with to_iso_bytes() and introduced CSOCompressor for standalone pure-Python CSO compression and decompression.
  • Registered PSPRomHandler in RomManager with high precedence over generic ISO 9660 handlers.
  • Nintendo DS NSBMD 3D Model Engine (miorom.platforms.nds.nsbmd / miorom.platforms.nds):
  • Implemented analytical parser, builder, model hierarchy inspector, and bidirectional texture extraction/injection engine for official Nintendo DS 3D model containers (.nsbmd / BMD0 & MDL0) with 100% zero external dependencies (NSBMDFile, NSBMDModel, NSBMDMaterial, BMD0HeaderStruct, MDL0HeaderStruct, create_synthetic_nsbmd).
  • Implemented declarative low-level binary headers (BMD0HeaderStruct, MDL0HeaderStruct) strictly via miorom.core.schema.BinaryStruct ensuring unified struct processing without raw struct operations.
  • Added object-oriented model and material hierarchy inspection (NSBMDModel, NSBMDMaterial), extracting model dictionaries, bone nodes, and material-to-texture/palette linkages.
  • Implemented bidirectional texture bridge with NSBTXFile, adding export_nsbtx() / export_nsbtx_file() to dump embedded TEX0 sections to standalone .nsbtx files, and import_nsbtx() / replace_texture() to inject custom/translated textures without disturbing 3D display list bytecode or bone meshes.
  • Added texture stripping (strip_textures()), seamlessly converting 2-block containers into single-block MDL0-only models and downsizing the block offset table.
  • Added relational texture auditing (validate_textures()), verifying whether all textures and palettes referenced across materials are present in the embedded TEX0 block.
  • Enhanced NSBTXFile with from_tex0_bytes() and to_tex0_bytes() for modular texture block parsing and serialization without code duplication.
  • Integrated directly into NDSRom (get_model(), set_model()).
  • Nintendo DS Cartridge Banner Engine (miorom.platforms.nds.banner / miorom.platforms.nds):
  • Implemented analytical parser, builder, image converter, and multilingual title editor for official Nintendo DS banner containers (banner.bin) with 100% zero external dependencies (NDSBanner, NDSBannerHeaderStruct, bgr555_to_rgb, rgb_to_bgr555).
  • Implemented declarative 32-byte binary header (NDSBannerHeaderStruct) strictly via miorom.core.schema.BinaryStruct ensuring unified struct processing without raw struct operations.
  • Added 32x32 4bpp tiled icon bitmap decoding and encoding (get_pixel_indices(), set_pixel_indices()), converting between 16 hardware 8x8 pixel tiles (arranged in a 4x4 tile grid) and 2D index arrays.
  • Added 16-color BGR555 palette parsing and serialization, strictly treating color index 0 as transparent background (alpha = 0) and indices 1..15 as opaque colors (alpha = 255).
  • Added bidirectional image bridge (to_image(), to_rgba_bytes(), set_image()), rendering icons to RGBA PIL Image and quantizing 32x32 user images into optimal 16-color palettes with Euclidean color distance matching in 15-bit RGB space.
  • Added multilingual title management supporting up to 8 languages (get_title(), set_title() for Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, Spanish, Chinese, Korean) with even-aligned UTF-16LE null termination and multiline newline (\n) handling.
  • Added automatic format version escalation (promoting version 1 to version 2 on Chinese title addition, and version 3 on Korean title addition).
  • Added bit-exact multi-range CRC16 recalculation and validation (is_crc_valid(), recalculate_crc()) computing crc_v1 (covering 0x0020..0x083F), crc_v2 (0x0020..0x093F), and crc_v3 (0x0020..0x0A3F) via RetroChecksum.crc16_modbus().
  • Integrated directly into NDSRom (get_banner(), set_banner(), get_banner_title()).
  • Nintendo DS Bottom LZ (BLZ / Backwards LZ77) Compression Engine (miorom.compression.blz / miorom.compression):
  • Implemented bit-exact analytical decompressor, compressor, format detector, and metadata trailer parser for Nintendo DS Bottom LZ (BLZ / Backwards LZ77) binaries with 100% zero external dependencies (BLZ, BLZTrailerStruct).
  • Implemented low-level declarative binary structure for the 8-byte trailer (BLZTrailerStruct) via miorom.core.schema.BinaryStruct ensuring unified struct processing without raw struct operations.
  • Added support for backwards LZ77 in-place RAM decompression (BLZ.decompress()), unpacking literals and 2-byte compressed tokens (displacement 3..4098, length 3..18) from inverted buffers with automatic payload inversion.
  • Added high-performance pure-Python LZ77 compressor (BLZ.compress()) with n-gram prefix hash table chaining for accelerated sliding window match finding across large executable binaries.
  • Added ARM9 Secure Area preservation mode (is_arm9=True), keeping the initial 16KB (0x4000) Secure Area uncompressed and automatically calculating/updating the 2KB Secure Area CRC16 at offset 0x0E via RetroChecksum.crc16_modbus().
  • Added automatic fallback for uncompressible binary streams, formatting output with 4-byte alignment padding and a 4-byte zero trailer compliant with CUE BLZ and official Nintendo SDK conventions.
  • Registered blz codec in miorom.compression registry for auto-detection and named dispatch (compress(data, fmt="blz"), decompress(data)).
  • Nintendo DS ARM9 & Overlay BLZ Integration (miorom.platforms.nds.rom / miorom.platforms.nds.overlay):
  • Enhanced NDSRom with ARM9 compression diagnostics and decompression utilities (is_arm9_compressed(), decompress_arm9(), compress_arm9(), and set_arm9_binary()), providing seamless ARM9 code modification and repacking workflows for translators.
  • Enhanced NDSOverlayCompressor in miorom.platforms.nds.overlay to automatically detect, decompress, and compress overlay payloads (y9.bin/y7.bin) using either standard BIOS LZ10 or BLZ backwards LZ77 (NDSOverlayCompressor.is_compressed(), decompress(), compress(codec="blz")).
  • Nintendo MSBF Dialogue Flowchart Engine (miorom.text.msbf / miorom.text / miorom.platforms.wii):
  • Implemented analytical parser, builder, graph visualizer, and bidirectional MSBT synchronization engine for Nintendo MSBF (.msbf, magic MsgFlwBn) dialogue flowchart and event logic files with 100% zero external dependencies (MSBFFile, FlowNode, MessageNode, ChoiceNode, EventNode, create_synthetic_msbf, MSBFHeaderStruct, MSBFSectionHeaderStruct, FLW3HeaderStruct, FLW3NodeStruct).
  • Implemented declarative low-level binary structures strictly via miorom.core.schema.BinaryStruct ensuring unified binary packing/unpacking and zero redundant struct logic.
  • Implemented high-level directed node graph model transforming raw 16-byte FLW3 nodes and branch table jump indices into intuitive object-oriented nodes (MessageNode for dialogue lines, ChoiceNode for branching player decisions, EventNode for script triggers).
  • Added bidirectional MSBT linking (link_msbt()) automatically cross-referencing message node indices with MSBTFile labels and dialogue text strings to provide human-readable text previews during flowchart analysis.
  • Added Markdown Mermaid flowchart diagram generation (to_mermaid()) rendering full conversation trees and branching decision paths directly into standard flowchart TD diagrams for visual story auditing.
  • Implemented lossless JSON dictionary serialization and deserialization (to_dict(), from_dict()) for automated script translation tools and dialog tree editors.
  • Added bit-exact binary serialization (to_bytes(), save()) with automatic branch table assembly, FEN1 entry points hash table generation, and 16-byte section padding.
  • Nintendo GameCube & Wii THP Video Cutscene Engine (miorom.platforms.wii.thp / miorom.platforms.wii):
  • Implemented analytical parser, demuxer, muxer, cutscene audio dubbing, and video frame replacement (hardsubbing) engine for official Nintendo THP video containers (.thp, magic THP\0) with 100% zero external dependencies (THPMovie, THPFrame, create_synthetic_thp, THPHeaderStruct, THPComponentHeaderStruct, THPVideoInfoStruct, THPAudioInfoStruct, THPFrameHeaderStruct, THPAudioFrameHeaderStruct).
  • Implemented declarative low-level binary structures strictly via miorom.core.schema.BinaryStruct ensuring unified struct processing and zero redundant parsing logic.
  • Added Motion JPEG video frame extraction and individual frame image replacement (get_frame(), export_frames(), replace_frame()), allowing modders and translators to extract clean video frames and burn translated text subtitles directly into video frames for hardsubbing.
  • Added multi-channel interleaved DSP-ADPCM cutscene audio demuxing (export_audio_wav()) seamlessly concatenating frame-by-frame audio slices into a single continuous 16-bit PCM WavSound stream.
  • Added zero-drift cutscene audio dubbing replacement (set_audio_wav()) employing high-precision fractional sample accumulators to interleave custom WAV audio across arbitrary cutscene frame counts without desync.
  • Implemented bit-exact movie remuxing (to_bytes(), save()) with automatic recalculation of max_buffer_size, max_audio_samples, and bidirectional frame linkages (prev_frame_size, next_frame_size).
  • Added full support for silent video-only movies (single video component).
  • Nintendo Wii BRSAR Sound Archive Engine (miorom.platforms.wii.brsar / miorom.platforms.wii):
  • Implemented analytical parser, builder, extractor, and automated cross-archive voice undubbing engine for Nintendo NW4R monolithic sound archives (.brsar, magic RSAR) with 100% zero external dependencies (BRSARSoundArchive, SoundEntry, UndubTransferReport, RWSDFile, create_synthetic_brsar, BRSARHeaderStruct, SYMBHeaderStruct, INFOHeaderStruct, FILEHeaderStruct, RWSDHeaderStruct, WSD1HeaderStruct, DATAHeaderStruct).
  • Added full relational parsing across all archive sections (RSAR header, SYMB symbol table, INFO parameter tables, and FILE payload section), resolving developer symbol strings to internal Sound IDs and File IDs.
  • Implemented analytical RWSDFile (Revolution Wave Sound Data) sub-file handler parsing WSD1 wave descriptors and DATA audio blocks with DSP-ADPCM and 16-bit uncompressed PCM codecs.
  • Added bi-directional WAV audio bridge (export_wav(), import_wav()) allowing audio modders and translators to extract voice clips and sound effects directly to standard 16-bit PCM WavSound / WAV files, and replace voice lines with custom WAVs automatically encoded into hardware DSP-ADPCM.
  • Added automated 32-byte (0x20) DMA-compliant payload alignment and relational offset/size recalculation across RSARHeaderStruct, INFOHeaderStruct, and the FILE section.
  • Implemented one-click cross-archive voice undubbing engine (apply_undub_from()) to automatically match and transfer voice clips (e.g. VO_ prefix) from Japanese BRSAR archives into USA/European BRSAR archives while keeping sound effects and musical sequences untouched.
  • Nintendo Wii & GameCube Opening Banner Engine (miorom.platforms.wii.banner / miorom.platforms.wii):
  • Implemented analytical parser, builder, and multimedia extractor for Nintendo Wii and GameCube opening banner containers (opening.bnr / 00000000.app) with 100% zero external dependencies (WiiBanner, GCBanner, BannerFile, IMETHeaderStruct, IMD5HeaderStruct, GCBannerHeaderStruct, GCCommentStruct, BNSHeaderStruct).
  • Added full support for Wii IMET headers across 10 official languages (Japanese, English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Dutch, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean) with automatic UTF-16-BE string conversion and Nintendo MD5 checksum calculation.
  • Implemented IMD5 wrapper parsing and automatic re-wrapping with payload MD5 recalculation for meta/banner.bin, meta/icon.bin, and meta/sound.bin.
  • Added pure-Python BNS (Banner Nintendo Sound) audio decoder and encoder converting between BNS DSP-ADPCM / PCM16 streams and standard WAV format (get_sound_wav(), set_sound_wav()).
  • Added GameCube BNR1 (single-language) and BNR2 (6-language) banner support with 96x32 RGB5A3 hardware micro-tile image decoding and encoding via PNGImage with alpha transparency.
  • Added unified factory BannerFile.from_bytes() with automatic format discrimination between Wii and GameCube banners.
  • Integrated directly into WiiDisc (get_banner(), set_banner()) and WiiRomHandler (extracting sys/opening.bnr on unpack and re-injecting during disc repacking).
  • Nintendo Wii BRLYT UI Layout Engine (miorom.platforms.wii.brlyt / miorom.platforms.wii):
  • Implemented dual-layer analytical parser, tree hierarchy reconstructor, and surgical mutation engine for Nintendo NW4R BRLYT (.brlyt, magic RLYT) user interface and HUD layout containers (BRLYTFile, BasePane, Pane, PicturePane, TextBoxPane, GenericPane, BRLYTHeaderStruct, BRLYTLyt1Struct, BRLYTPaneStruct, BRLYTPic1Struct, BRLYTTxt1Struct, BRLYTResourceListHeaderStruct).
  • Added full tree hierarchy reconstruction parsing pas1 (Pane Start / push) and pae1 (Pane End / pop) delimiter chunks into structured parent-child node graphs with pre-order traversal (iter_tree(), find_pane(), find_text_boxes()).
  • Implemented rich text manipulation for txt1 panes with UTF-16-BE string encoding, dynamic RAM buffer capacity expansion (str_buf_len), and buffer overflow protection (expand_buffer=False guard).
  • Added automated font list (fnl1) and texture list (txl1) string table parsing and rebuilding (parse_resource_list(), build_resource_list()).
  • Added font remapping (remap_font()) allowing translators to redirect text box font bindings from Japanese kanji fonts to custom Latin fonts (e.g. created via BRFNTFont) with automatic fnl1 table synchronization.
  • Implemented localization dictionary export/import (export_strings(), import_strings()) to streamline UI translation and script dumping workflows.
  • Preserved complete backward compatibility with legacy section-level primitives (parse_brlyt_sections, rebuild_brlyt, find_pane, update_pane).
  • Nintendo Wii BRFNT Font & TGLP Glyph Sheet Engine (miorom.platforms.wii.brfnt / miorom.platforms.wii):
  • Implemented analytical parser, builder, and font expansion engine for Nintendo NW4R BRFNT (.brfnt, magic RFNT) and Nintendo DS NFTR (.nftr, magic FONT) font containers (BRFNTFont, BRFNTHeaderStruct, BRFNTFinfStruct, BRFNTTglpStruct, BRFNTWidthHeaderStruct, BRFNTCharMapHeaderStruct, CharWidth).
  • Added multi-format Nintendo GX hardware texture decoding and encoding for font sheets supporting I4, I8, IA4, IA8, and RGBA8 micro-tile formats with zero external dependencies.
  • Implemented single glyph and full sheet PNG image extraction and surgical replacement (get_sheet_image(), export_sheets(), get_glyph_image(), inject_glyph_image()) via PNGImage with transparent alpha.
  • Implemented dynamic font expansion (add_character()) allowing modders and translators to inject accented Latin characters (é, è, ê, ô, ç, ñ), Indonesian letters, and custom controller button glyphs into unused sheet cells with automatic CMAP and CWDH registration.
  • Added deterministic binary serialization (to_bytes(), save()) and clean font instantiation (BRFNTFont.create()).
  • Nintendo Wii Riivolution XML Mod Engine (miorom.platforms.wii.riivolution / miorom.platforms.wii / miorom.patch):
  • Implemented analytical parser, serializer, automated diff packager, and virtual disc patcher for Nintendo Wii Riivolution mod configurations (.xml, <wiidisc>) with 100% zero external dependencies (RiivolutionFile, RiivolutionPatch, FileRedirect, FolderRedirect, MemoryPatch, RiivolutionOption, RiivolutionChoice, RiivolutionSection).
  • Added automated fast recursive directory diffing (create_riivolution_package()) using size checks and chunked SHA-256 streaming hashing to compare clean retail dumps against modded projects, isolating delta assets and generating ready-to-use SD card / Dolphin layouts (riivolution/{mod_name}.xml and {mod_name}/...).
  • Implemented in-memory virtual disc patching (apply_riivolution_to_disc()) applying <file>, <folder>, and surgical <memory> patches directly to decrypted WiiDisc partitions and main.dol executables, allowing modders to repack patched games into standalone .iso, .wbfs, or .rvz ROMs without physical consoles.
  • Added unified CLI subcommands in miorom patch: export-riivolution (diffing & package generation) and apply-riivolution (direct disc patching).
  • Dolphin RVZ / WIA Compressed Optical Disc Engine (miorom.platforms.iso.rvz / miorom.platforms.iso):
  • Implemented analytical parser, lazy chunk decompressor, and bit-exact builder for Dolphin WIA v2 / RVZ (.rvz, magic RVZ\x01 / WIA\x01) compressed optical disc images (RVZDisc, RVZFileHeadStruct, RVZDiscHeadStruct, RVZGroupStruct, RVZRawDataStruct).
  • Added multi-algorithm streaming decompressor supporting Zstandard (zstd), LZMA/LZMA2 (lzma), Bzip2 (bz2), raw uncompressed chunks, and sparse zero-chunk skipping (data_size == 0).
  • Implemented pure-Python Lagged Fibonacci PRNG padding generator ($f = \text{xor}, j = 32, k = 521$) and Dolphin RVZ packing byte-stream decoder to faithfully reconstruct uncompressed disc padding.
  • Implemented chunk-level LRU virtual disc streaming (read_at(virtual_offset, size)) maintaining strict memory bounds (< 16 MB RAM) across multi-gigabyte Wii DVD-5 / DVD-9 and GameCube disc images.
  • Integrated bidirectional RVZ support into WiiDisc (from_stream(), to_rvz(), save_rvz()), WiiRomHandler (unpack, repack(format="rvz")), and GameCubeRomHandler (unpack, repack(format="rvz")).
  • Added instant format discrimination in RomManager checking the 128-byte dhead header without decompressing disc payload, seamlessly routing Wii RVZs to WiiRomHandler and GameCube RVZs to GameCubeRomHandler.
  • Nintendo Wii ROM Handler & CLI Integration (miorom.rom.handlers.wii / miorom.rom):
  • Implemented WiiRomHandler connecting WiiDisc and WBFSDisc engines directly into RomManager and the unified CLI pipeline (miorom unpack, miorom pack).
  • Added automatic container format detection via WBFS magic (offset 0x00), Wii Disc magic 0x5D1C9EA3 (offset 0x18), and partition table validation at 0x40000.
  • Added structured extraction into sys/ (header.bin, boot.bin, bi2.bin, apploader.img, main.dol, ticket.bin, tmd.bin) and root/ (all FST virtual game assets), generating complete miorom.meta.json manifests.
  • Implemented bit-exact repacking from modified filesystem folders with automatic FST re-indexing, cluster AES-128 re-encryption, H0–H3 hash tree generation, and Trucha Bug null RSA-2048 fake-signing, supporting both .iso and sparse .wbfs output targets.
  • Nintendo Wii & GameCube BRSTM Audio Stream Engine (miorom.platforms.wii.brstm / miorom.platforms.wii / miorom.audio):
  • Implemented analytical parser, builder, decoder, and encoder for Nintendo NW4R BRSTM (.brstm, magic RSTM) multi-channel streaming audio containers used throughout Nintendo Wii and GameCube titles (BRSTMFile, BRSTMChannelInfo, BRSTMHeaderStruct, BRSTMHeadPart1Struct, encode_dsp_adpcm_channel).
  • Added pure-Python multi-channel interleaved DSP-ADPCM decoder reconstructing signed 16-bit PCM audio with 16 dual-tap linear prediction coefficients, initial history samples, and scale exponent unpackers.
  • Implemented pure-Python DSP-ADPCM audio encoder optimizing 16 scale factors and predictor coefficients per 8-byte (14-sample) frame with squared-error minimization and clamp protection.
  • Added bidirectional bridge with WavCodec and WavSound (to_wav(), BRSTMFile.from_wav()) allowing audio modders and translators to convert custom WAV music and voice lines into retail-ready looping BRSTM streams and vice versa.
  • Implemented in-memory loop point editor (set_loop(loop_start, total_samples)) and diagnostic inspection API (summary()) calculating exact audio duration and loop repetition periods.
  • Nintendo Wii BRLAN Layout Animation Engine (miorom.platforms.wii.brlan / miorom.platforms.wii):
  • Implemented analytical parser, builder, and mathematical timeline curve evaluator for Nintendo NW4R layout animation files (.brlan, magic RLAN) accompanying BRLYT layouts (BRLANFile, BRLANPaneAnim, BRLANTrack, BRLANKeyframe).
  • Added mathematical timeline curve evaluator (evaluate(frame: float)) supporting Step (constant), Linear, and cubic Hermite spline interpolation with smooth tangents for UI animations (translations, rotations, scale, dimensions, alpha transparency, vertex colors, and UV coordinate scrolling).
  • Implemented in-memory keyframe manipulation API (set_keyframe(), remove_keyframe()) and global animation duration scaling (scale_duration()) allowing translators and modders to speed up or expand UI transitions (e.g. dialogue box animations).
  • Added deterministic 4-byte and 16-byte aligned binary rebuilding (to_bytes(), save()).
  • Implemented direct interoperability with BRLYT layout panes (BRLYTPaneStruct, BRLYTPic1Struct).
  • Nintendo Wii Optical Disc & WBFS Partition Engine (miorom.platforms.wii.disc / miorom.platforms.wii):
  • Implemented pure-Python, zero-dependency reverse engineering engine for Nintendo Wii optical disc images (.iso / .wii) and sparse block containers (.wbfs) (WiiDisc, WiiPartition, WiiDiscHeader, WiiPartitionInfo, WBFSDisc).
  • Added streaming lazy cluster decryption (< 50 MB RAM usage even for full 8.5 GB dual-layer retail DVD-9 disc images) resolving 32 KB clusters on-demand.
  • Implemented physical Partition Information Table parsing at 0x40000 supporting multiple cryptographically isolated partitions (Data, Update, Channel).
  • Implemented AES-128 Title Key decryption via retail and Korean Wii Common Keys using aes128_cbc_decrypt.
  • Implemented 4-level hierarchical hash tree engine: 31 SHA-1 sub-hashes (H0) per 32 KB cluster, H1 group hashing (8 clusters = 160 bytes), H2 group hashing (64 clusters / 2 MB = 160 bytes), and H3 root table hashing with automatic TMD content record validation.
  • Implemented recursive depth-first FST (File System Table) builder, directory traversal, and on-demand file extraction (sys/boot.bin, sys/bi2.bin, sys/apploader.img, sys/main.dol, and nested files/ game assets).
  • Implemented in-memory file replacement and surgical injection (disc.partitions[0]["files/..."] = new_bytes), automatic FST layout re-indexing, and Trucha Bug fake-signing (null RSA-2048 digital signatures) on modified Tickets and TMDs.
  • Added bi-directional repacking to standard playable .iso and sparse .wbfs containers.
  • Nintendo Wii BRRES & TEX0 Resource Engine (miorom.platforms.wii.tpl / miorom.platforms.wii):
  • Implemented analytical parser, builder, and texture replacement engine for Nintendo's NW4R BRRES (Binary Revolution Resource) archive container (BRRESFile, TEX0Image, PLT0Palette, BresIndexGroup, BresIndexEntry), the universal resource package used across modern Wii games (Mario Kart Wii, Super Smash Bros. Brawl, Xenoblade Chronicles, The Legend of Zelda: Skyward Sword, etc.).
  • Implemented pure-Python bitwise Patricia trie dictionary builder and $O(k)$ search engine (BresIndexGroup.build(), find(), to_bytes(), from_bytes()) calculating exact character indices and bit comparison discriminators matching Nintendo NW4R specifications.
  • Reused centralized Nintendo GX hardware texture codecs in tpl.py (decode_gx_texture, encode_gx_texture) with zero duplication, supporting CMPR (S3TC/DXT1), RGB565, RGB5A3, RGBA8, I4, I8, IA4, IA8, CI4, and CI8 with 100% zero external dependencies.
  • Implemented 100% byte-exact preservation of non-texture sections (MDL0 3D models, CHR0 skeletal animations, CLR0, PAT0, SRT0, SHP0, SCN0) stored in other_sections, ensuring that editing textures never corrupts or destabilizes character models or animations.
  • Added deterministic 32-byte section alignment and relative PowerPC signed 32-bit bres_offset calculations.
  • Added bidirectional to_image(), to_png(), and from_image() support with automatic color quantization for CI4 and CI8 paletted textures.
  • Nintendo Wii WAD Package Engine & Direct U8 Bridge (miorom.platforms.wii.u8 / miorom.platforms.wii):
  • Implemented full parser, serializer, and surgical modifier for Nintendo Wii installable packages (WADFile, WADTicket, WADTmd, WADContentRecord), used for WiiWare, Virtual Console, Channels, and DLCs.
  • Implemented standalone pure-Python table-driven AES-128-CBC cipher (aes128_cbc_encrypt, aes128_cbc_decrypt) with 100% zero external dependencies, verified against NIST SP 800-38A standard vectors.
  • Enforced strict key safety without proprietary hardcoded keys: callers supply common_key: bytes or title_key: bytes on demand, while raw chunks remain fully inspectable without keys.
  • Implemented seamless in-memory bridge between WAD contents (.app files) and U8Archive (wad.get_u8_archive(), wad.set_u8_archive()), allowing translators to directly browse, unpack, patch, and repack WiiWare game filesystems without temporary disk extraction.
  • Added automatic SHA-1 hash and size recalculation in TMD records, along with standard Trucha Bug RSA null-signature fake-signing (wad.to_bytes(fake_sign=True)).
  • Enhanced U8Archive with full mutable in-memory dictionary-like API (__init__, from_bytes(), to_bytes(), save(), __getitem__, __setitem__, keys(), values(), items()).
  • Sony PlayStation Portable (PSP) GIM Texture & VRAM Swizzle Engine (miorom.platforms.psp.pbp / miorom.platforms.psp):
  • Implemented analytical parser, builder, and zero-dependency surgical image modifier for Sony GIM (Graphic Image Map) textures and micro-tiled PSP GE VRAM swizzle layouts (GIMImage, GIMFormat, GIMPixelOrder, psp_swizzle, psp_unswizzle).
  • Added pure-Python mathematical codec for PSP GE 16×8-byte (128-byte) micro-tile swizzling and unswizzling across 4bpp, 8bpp, 16bpp, and 32bpp textures with zero external dependencies.
  • Added support for all standard PSP GIM pixel formats: RGBA8888, RGBA5551, RGBA4444, RGBA5650, INDEX4 (16-color CLUT), and INDEX8 (256-color CLUT) with deterministic chunk serialization (to_bytes()) and bidirectional conversion to PNGImage / PIL Image.
  • Implemented surgical ROM hacking sub-region patching (patch_region()) and sub-region extraction (extract_region()) enabling translators to replace dialogue font characters or UI buttons with automatic, transparent unswizzling/re-swizzling and CLUT color matching.
  • Added embedded GIM texture scanning (find_gim_textures()) and icon helpers (get_icon(), set_icon()) in PBPFile.
  • Nintendo GameCube & Wii Relocatable Module (REL) Engine (miorom.link.dol / miorom.platforms.wii):
  • Implemented analytical parser, serializer, and surgical patcher for Nintendo dynamic executable modules (.rel) supporting format versions 1, 2, and 3 with zero external dependencies and 100% miorom.core.schema serializations.
  • Implemented state-machine relocation decoder and deterministic delta bytecode rebuilder with automatic R_RVL_NONE (201) pagination for offset gaps > 65,535 bytes to prevent 16-bit integer truncation in large data/string sections.
  • Added engineering analytical queries: find_relocations(), find_relocations_in_range(), find_references_to_symbol(), and summary().
  • Added surgical relocation shifting (shift_relocations()) allowing reverse engineers to insert expanded localized dialogue strings into data sections without breaking internal or cross-module pointer references.
  • Added non-destructive simulated PowerPC relocation resolution (simulate_resolve_section(), link_against_dol(), and DolBinary.resolve_rel()) to resolve 32-bit addresses (R_PPC_ADDR32, ADDR16_LO, ADDR16_HI, ADDR16_HA) and 24-bit relative branches (R_PPC_REL24, REL14) for disassembly with UniversalDisassembler.
  • Zero-Dependency RIFF/WAVE Audio Codec (miorom.audio.wav_codec) & Unified Audio CLI (miorom audio):
  • Implemented standalone WavCodec and WavSound container using purely miorom.core.schema with zero external dependencies. Supports encoding and decoding 8-bit unsigned, 16-bit signed, 24-bit PCM, and 32-bit IEEE float audio in mono or stereo.
  • Added seamless conversions: VAGFile.from_wav / .to_wav(), BRRCodec.from_wav / .to_wav(), DSPADPCMCodec.to_wav(), and centralized ADPCMCodec.build_wav / read_wav through WavCodec.
  • Added miorom audio CLI suite with convert (bidirectional transcoding between WAV, VAG, BRR, and DSP), extract (dumping WAVs from SPC audio RAM and SDAT sound archives), and info (inspecting sample rate, bit depth, channel layout, sample count, duration, and container headers with optional --json output).
  • Zero-Dependency PNG Codec & Standalone Image I/O (miorom.graphics.png_codec): Extracted and expanded the pure-Python PNG codec into a first-class module (PNGCodec, PNGImage, PNGColorType). Supports all PNG reconstruction filter algorithms (None, Sub, Up, Average, Paeth), multiple color modes (Grayscale, RGB, RGBA, Indexed with PLTE, Grayscale+Alpha with tRNS), and sub-byte bit depths (1, 2, 4, 8).
  • Zero-Dependency Graphics Fallbacks across All Platform Formats: Unblocked image export/import without Pillow across ImageBridge, TIMImage (PSX), TPLFile (Wii/GC), BTIImage (Wii/GC), NCERFile (NDS), NSBTXFile (NDS), GlyphBank, and MemoryCard (PSX).
