Added dedicated .to_png() / save_icon_png() methods to enable seamless extraction and insertion of textures, tiles, fonts, and icons directly into PNG files even in strictly zero-dependency environments.
  • Unified CLI Patching Suite & Patch Inspection (miorom patch): Added hierarchical miorom patch subcommands (apply, create, inspect) supporting BPS, IPS, PPF (v1/v2/v3), UPS, and XDelta with automated format detection via header magic bytes and extension fallback. Added standalone inspect_patch() and .inspect() methods across patchers to diagnose target sizes, CRC32 checksum validity, and record counts without altering ROMs.

docs.title: Changed
docs.text: • Unified Binary Serialization via miorom.core.schema: Fully deprecated and eliminated raw Python struct imports across all 114 engine modules in src/miorom. All binary deserialization, packing, bytefield definitions, and endian-aware operations are now routed natively through miorom.core.schema (BinaryStruct, U8, I8, U16, I16, U32, I32, U64, I64, Float32, Float64, schema.pack, schema.unpack, schema.unpack_from, schema.pack_into, schema.calcsize, schema.Struct, schema.error), achieving zero direct dependencies on raw struct outside of the core schema engine.

docs.title: Fixed
docs.text:
• Nintendo MSBT Text Engine MSBTFile — UTF-8 control tag \x0E string truncation on null arguments, ATR1 attribute section omission, unlabelled string drop, and non-destructive custom section preservation (miorom.text.msbt):
  • UTF-8 Dialogue Control Tag Truncation: In MSBTFile.from_bytes(), UTF-8 strings were read with sec_data.find(b"\x00", off). In official Nintendo MSBT format, control tags in UTF-8 begin with 0x0E, followed by a 6-byte header (group ID, tag ID, and argument length as uint16) and arg_len argument bytes. Whenever any parameter inside the control tag (e.g. font color, wait frames, player variables, speed) contained a zero byte (0x00), find() stopped prematurely at the null byte inside the control tag, truncating the sentence and permanently destroying all dialogue text after the tag. Fixed by parsing the control tag header and skipping 7 + arg_len bytes in UTF-8 mode, ensuring string parsing only terminates at authentic dialogue null delimiters.
  • ATR1 Attribute Section Omission & Dropped Message Attributes: MSBTEntry declares attributes: bytes = b"", but MSBTFile.from_bytes() completely ignored ATR1 sections, leaving all message attributes empty. Furthermore, to_bytes() hardcoded section_count = 2, dropping ATR1 and destroying any custom sections (e.g. TSY1 style tables, NLI1, ATO1), which caused games like Super Mario Galaxy and The Legend of Zelda to crash upon loading repacked MSBTs. Fixed by parsing ATR1 entries into MSBTEntry.attributes, generating ATR1 during to_bytes() whenever attributes are present, preserving all unrecognized sections in other_sections, and dynamically computing section_count = len(sections).
  • Unlabelled Dialogue String Loss: from_bytes() previously built entries solely by iterating over labels. If an MSBT file contained strings in TXT2 without corresponding labels in LBL1 (or if label entries were sparse), unlabelled strings were silently discarded, shifting subsequent string indices and breaking game dialog lookups. Fixed by mapping all strings $0 \le i < \text{str_count}$, resolving to existing labels or fallback STR_{i}. Added regression tests in tests/test_text_bmg_msbt.py.
  • Nintendo DS Cartridge ROM Header CRC-16 Checksum Conflict & RetroChecksum.crc16_nds (miorom.platforms.nds.rom, miorom.core.integrity, miorom.rom.handlers.nds, miorom.core.checksum):
  • Header Checksum Algorithm Desynchronization & Hardware Boot Failure: In src/miorom/platforms/nds/rom.py, calculate_nds_crc16() was erroneously implemented using reflected polynomial 0xA001 (CRC-16-IBM / Modbus). Official Nintendo DS hardware and ARM7/ARM9 BIOS Boot ROM SWI 0x0E verify the cartridge header at offset 0x15E covering bytes 0x000..0x15D using reflected polynomial 0x8408 (CRC-16-CCITT / Kermit). Consequently, NDSRom.verify_header_checksum() returned False on valid retail NDS ROMs, ROMs repacked by NDSRomHandler, and ROMs repaired by RomIntegrityManager. Moreover, NDSRom.fix_header_checksum() wrote the incorrect 0xA001 checksum into offset 0x15E, rendering the ROM unbootable on authentic DS hardware and emulators (DeSmuME, melonDS). Fixed by adding RetroChecksum.crc16_nds() (poly 0x8408, init 0xFFFF), unifying calculate_nds_crc16() across rom.py, handlers/nds.py, and integrity.py, and adding is_header_checksum_valid() to NDSRom. Added regression tests in tests/test_nds.py.
  • IPS Patcher IpsPatcher — Silent byte loss at offset 0x454F46 (b"EOF"), apply_stream overlapping hunks corruption, and truncation preservation (miorom.patch.ips):
  • Silent Byte Truncation on Offset Collision: When generating an IPS patch via IpsPatcher.create(), if a modified byte run started at offset 0x454F46 (the ASCII value of "EOF"), the code previously did start = 0x454F47; i = 0x454F47. This jumped over byte 0x454F46, silently omitting the user's change at that exact offset and leaving it unpatched. Fixed by stepping back 1 byte to start = 0x454F45 and prepending modified[0x454F45] to diff_bytes, safely bypassing the EOF collision without discarding byte 0x454F46.
  • apply_stream Overlapping Records Desynchronization & Truncation: In IpsPatcher.apply_stream(), hunks were sorted but not merged via merge_patches(). When an IPS patch contained overlapping records, current_pos < hunk.offset evaluated to False and output_stream.write(hunk.data) wrote at the current stream pointer without seeking back, shifting subsequent file data and corrupting the output stream. Additionally, apply_stream ignored the optional 3-byte truncation offset after EOF. Fixed by merging hunks with merge_patches() and strictly enforcing truncate_size. Added regression tests in tests/test_patch.py.
  • Multi-Track CD-ROM Engine CueBinDisc — Mode 2 Form 1 subheader and EDC corruption, Mode 1 Yellow Book EDC invalidity, and single-BIN multi-track desynchronization (miorom.platforms.cdrom.disc):
  • Mode 2 Form 1 CD-ROM Track Corruption: When replacing data in MODE2/2352 tracks (e.g. PS1, Sega Saturn), CueBinDisc.replace_track_data() hardcoded Mode 1 formatting (header mode = 0x01), omitted the mandatory 8-byte subheader (0x00 0x00 0x08 0x00 0x00 0x00 0x08 0x00), placed user data at byte 16 instead of byte 24 (causing an 8-byte shift that truncated the first 8 bytes of every sector), and wrote EDC at offset 2064 instead of 2072. Fixed by building standards-compliant Mode 2 Form 1 sectors with subheaders and EDC at offset 2072.
  • Mode 1 Yellow Book EDC Checksum Omission: In Mode 1, replace_track_data() calculated EDC over header + chunk (2052 bytes), omitting SYNC_PATTERN. According to ECMA-130 section 14.3, Mode 1 EDC is generated over bytes 0..2063 (2064 bytes) including the sync pattern. Fixed by calculating EDC over sector[:2064].
  • Multi-Track Single-BIN Index Desynchronization: When a data track was expanded/contracted in a single-BIN disc, subsequent audio and data tracks retained stale LBA indices in the CUE sheet, causing audio and data to read from misaligned offsets. Fixed by updating subsequent track indices by delta_sectors. Added regression tests in tests/test_platforms_cdrom.py.
  • Nintendo Wii ROM Handler WiiRomHandler — Disc Title ID specification violation and non-destructive in-memory banner staging (miorom.rom.handlers.wii):
  • Disc Title ID Specification Violation: In WiiRomHandler.repack(), the default Ticket and TMD Title ID was formatted as title_id=header.game_id[:4] + b"\x00"*4 (e.g. b"RMCE\x00\x00\x00\x00"), violating the official Wii Title ID specification where disc titles require prefix 00010000 (b"\x00\x01\x00\x00"). Fixed by formatting Title ID as b"\x00\x01\x00\x00" + header.game_id[:4].
  • Non-Destructive In-Memory Banner Staging: repack() previously wrote opening.bnr directly to root_dir/opening.bnr on disk, mutating the user's project files during repack. Fixed by staging part["files/opening.bnr"] in memory. Added regression tests in tests/test_rom_handlers_wii.py.
  • ISO 9660 Filesystem ISO9660 — Sector alignment guard on file extent relocation (miorom.platforms.iso.iso9660):
  • Sector Alignment on Append: In ISO9660.replace_file(), if an enlarged file was appended to an ISO whose length was not an exact multiple of 2048 bytes, target_lba calculated from len(self.data) // 2048 desynchronized from the actual appended byte offset. Fixed by padding self.data to a 2048-byte sector boundary before calculating target_lba and extending data. Added regression tests in tests/test_iso9660_builder.py.
  • Nintendo GameCube GameCubeRomHandler — RVZ unpack disc_base.bin omission producing unbootable repacked discs, extraction of sys/main.dol, and modified executable & header injection during repack (miorom.rom.handlers.gc):
  • RVZ Unpack disc_base.bin Omission: In GameCubeRomHandler.unpack_rvz(), sys/header.bin and virtual files in root/ were extracted, but sys/disc_base.bin was omitted. When repacking from this directory, repack() failed to find disc_base.bin and fell back to synthesizing a 0x450000-byte zeroed disc base, wiping out the apploader, bi2.bin, and the executable main.dol, producing an unbootable disc. Fixed by extracting sys/disc_base.bin up to fst_offset directly from the RVZ disc stream.
  • Extraction of sys/main.dol: In unpack(), unpack_file(), and unpack_rvz(), sys/main.dol was never extracted as a standalone file, impeding disassembly, reverse engineering, and ASM hacks. Added automated detection and extraction of sys/main.dol using DolBinary to calculate exact text/data section bounds.
  • Repack Injection of Modified sys/main.dol & sys/header.bin: repack() previously ignored changes made to sys/main.dol and sys/header.bin whenever disc_base.bin was present. Enhanced repack() to detect updated sys/header.bin (refreshing disc.header and sector 0) and updated sys/main.dol (injecting the patched binary at dol_offset and safely elevating fst_offset if the executable expanded). Added regression tests in tests/test_platforms_gc.py and tests/test_platforms_iso_rvz.py.
  • Sony PlayStation 1 & PSP PSXRomHandler and PSPRomHandler — TypeError crash on filepath unpack, signature alignment, and filesystem clue format detection (miorom.rom.handlers.psx, miorom.rom.handlers.psp, miorom.rom.manager):
  • TypeError on Filepath Unpack: PSXRomHandler.unpack() and PSPRomHandler.unpack() previously declared signatures (self, data: bytes, output_dir: str) without **kwargs. When unpacked via RomManager.unpack(filepath, ...) or CLI miorom unpack, filepath=filepath was passed as a keyword argument, raising TypeError: unpack() got an unexpected keyword argument 'filepath' and crashing execution. Fixed by adding **kwargs to both handlers and leveraging PSXRom.from_file() / PSPRom.from_file() when streaming from disk.
  • Repack First Parameter Alignment & Format Inference Clues: Aligned the first parameter of repack() to input_dir matching BaseRomHandler, and added filesystem detection clues in RomManager.repack() for SYSTEM.CNF (psx), PSP_GAME (psp), and ticket.bin/tmd.bin (wii) to prevent unpacked directories from misidentifying as "u8". Added regression tests in tests/test_platforms_psx_rom.py and tests/test_platforms_psp_rom.py.
  • Nintendo GameCube, Wii, & DS BMGFile — Escape sequence text truncation on null parameters, and INF1 attributes & header parameter data loss (miorom.text.bmg):
  • Escape Sequence Text Truncation: In official Nintendo BMG files, dialogue escape/control sequences begin with 0x001A (in UTF-16BE) or 0x1A (in 8-bit encodings CP1252/Shift-JIS/UTF-8), followed by a 1-byte total sequence length. Parameters inside the escape sequence (e.g. RGB color 0, 0, 0, 255, player index 0, font index 0) frequently contain zero bytes (0x00 / 0x00 0x00). BMGFile.from_bytes() previously searched naively for null terminators with b"\x00\x00" or b"\x00", immediately truncating the dialogue string inside the escape sequence and destroying the remainder of the sentence. Fixed by parsing the escape code length and skipping the escape sequence body to preserve all text following formatted tags.
  • INF1 Message Attributes & Header Parameters Data Loss: In BMGFile.from_bytes(), inf_hdr.file_id and inf_hdr.default_color were dropped, and message attributes (sec_reader.skip(inf_hdr.entry_size - 4)) were discarded, leaving all messages with empty attributes = b"". In BMGFile.to_bytes(), entry_size was hardcoded to 8, corrupting games that use entry_size = 4 (no attributes) or entry_size = 12 (Twilight Princess with 8-byte attributes), and attributes were replaced with zeroes (inf_body.write_u32(0)). Fixed by capturing file_id, default_color, and inf_entry_size, reading and populating BMGMessage.attributes, and dynamically writing preserved or custom attributes. Added regression tests in tests/test_text_bmg_msbt.py.
  • Sega Mega Drive / Genesis MDHeader & MDRom — Backup RAM / SRAM mapping address erasure and configuration (miorom.platforms.md.rom):
  • SRAM Mapping Address Erasure: In Sega Genesis / Mega Drive cartridges, offset 0x01B0..0x01EF (64 bytes) defines the battery backup RAM (SRAM) configuration (start address 0x00200001, end address 0x00200FFF, backup RAM flags 0xF8 0x20, and memo fields). MDHeader.parse() previously checked only sram_support = _reserved_0xB0[:2] == b"RA" and discarded the entire 64-byte block. When saving or packing (MDHeader.pack() / MDRom.to_bytes()), reserved was allocated as zeroes with only b"RA" at the start, completely wiping out all SRAM start/end addresses and flags. This prevented saving from functioning in emulators, flashcarts, and hardware after editing with MDRom. Fixed by storing reserved_b0: bytes, preserving all 64 bytes of SRAM settings across roundtrips, adding sram_start and sram_end properties, and providing configure_sram() for non-SRAM ROMs. Added regression tests in tests/test_platforms_md.py.
  • Nintendo GameCube & Wii GCBanner, WiiBanner, & GCCommentStruct — European BNR2 character degradation, RGB5A3 buffer overrun crash, and UTF-16 surrogate preservation (miorom.platforms.wii.banner):
  • European BNR2 Multilingual Character Degradation to '?': In GameCube European PAL disc releases (BNR2), 6 language slots are defined (English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Dutch), all formatted in Windows-1252 (CP1252). GCCommentStruct hardcoded encoding="shift-jis" for title, company, and description fields. When saving European accented characters (e.g. Pokémon, Über, Español, Édition), Shift-JIS encoding failed and replaced every accented Latin character with ? (e.g. Pok?mon, ?ber). Fixed by implementing dynamic dual-encoding support in GCCommentStruct, defaulting to CP1252 for BNR2 and Shift-JIS for BNR1 with automatic fallback, and adding character-boundary safe truncation.
  • RGB5A3 Encoding Buffer Overrun: In encode_rgb5a3(), pixel extraction did not verify buffer length before indexing rgba[idx], causing unhandled IndexError when images with custom or smaller dimensions were supplied. Added explicit buffer length guards and enhanced GCBanner.set_image() to accept PNGImage, Image.Image, raw bytes, and file paths with Pillow-based automatic resizing.
  • Wii Opening Banner Language Aliases & Safe UTF-16 Truncation: Added language alias resolution (WII_LANGUAGE_ALIASES) to WiiBanner.get_title() and set_title() allowing human-readable names ("japanese", "english", "ja") and integer indices (0..9), and updated to_bytes() to truncate oversized UTF-16 strings along character boundaries rather than slicing raw bytes. Added regression tests in tests/test_platforms_wii_banner.py.
  • Nintendo DS NDSBanner & NDSRomHandler — Opaque black palette index 0 transparency hole, multilingual title truncation on extraction, invalid language index bounds, and auto-elevation (miorom.platforms.nds.banner, miorom.rom.handlers.nds):
  • Opaque Black Palette Index 0 Hardware Transparency Bug: In NDSBanner.set_image(), the quantizer mapped pixel colors to palette indices using if rgb_q in palette[1:]: pixel_indices[y][x] = palette.index(rgb_q). Because palette always stores (0, 0, 0) at index 0 (the hardware transparent color on NDS), any opaque black pixel (0, 0, 0, 255) (such as outlines, text, or pupils) evaluated palette.index((0, 0, 0)) to 0. Consequently, all opaque black pixels were assigned index 0, turning completely transparent (alpha = 0) on hardware, emulators, and PNG exports. Fixed by querying chosen_opaque directly and assigning 1 + chosen_opaque.index(rgb_q) for opaque pixels, strictly restricting index 0 to transparent pixels (alpha < 128).
  • NDSRomHandler.unpack() Multilingual & DSi Banner Truncation: In NDSRomHandler.unpack(), extracting banner.bin hardcoded 0x840 bytes (data[rom.banner_offset : rom.banner_offset + 0x840]). For v2 (Chinese, 0x940 bytes), v3 (Korean, 0xA40 bytes), and DSi (0x23C0 bytes) ROMs, this truncated the banner file, destroying extended titles and animated icons when unpacking and repacking ROMs. Fixed by inspecting banner version to extract the full b_size (0x840 for v1, 0x940 for v2, 0xA40 for v3, 0x23C0 for DSi).
  • Multilingual Title Version Auto-Elevation: In NDSBanner.to_bytes(), if a banner was initialized with Chinese (language 6) or Korean (language 7) directly in the titles dictionary with version=1, num_langs remained 6, silently omitting the Chinese and Korean titles from the binary output. Fixed by checking self.titles to automatically elevate num_langs to 7 or 8 and bump self.version to 2 or 3.
  • Language Index Bounds & Safe UTF-16 Truncation: Added strict bounds checking (0 <= idx <= 7) to _resolve_language_index() to prevent invalid language keys from corrupting internal dictionaries, and updated to_bytes() title serialization to truncate oversized strings along character boundaries rather than slicing raw bytes. Added regression tests in tests/test_platforms_nds_banner.py.
  • Sony PlayStation 1 PSXMemoryCard & PSXSaveFile — Shift-JIS title 32-byte truncation, multi-block directory entry standard violations, payload expansion truncation, and delete safety (miorom.platforms.psx.memory_card):
  • Shift-JIS Title Truncation to 32 Bytes: In official Sony PlayStation 1 save games, the save header title field at Frame 0 offset 0x04..0x43 allocates 64 bytes for Shift-JIS title text. PSXSaveHeaderStruct previously divided this region into title_raw = RawBytes(32) and _reserved_title_pad = RawBytes(32). When reading, _parse_save_content only decoded title_raw (ignoring bytes 33..64), and build_block_data() truncated encoded titles at [:32], actively destroying long Japanese game titles (e.g. ファイナルファンタジーVII クラウド レベル99 at 43 bytes was truncated to ファイナルファンタジーVII クラウ). Fixed by declaring title_raw = RawBytes(64) in PSXSaveHeaderStruct and supporting full 64-byte Shift-JIS titles across _parse_save_content, build_block_data(), and .mcs single-save file export/import.
  • Multi-Block Directory Entry Specification Compliance: In PSXMemoryCard.inject_file(), file_size and filename were previously written to every block directory entry in a multi-block save chain. According to the Sony PS1 memory card specification, only the initial block directory entry (0x51 / IN_USE_INITIAL) may contain file_size and filename; middle blocks (0x52 / IN_USE_MIDDLE) and last blocks (0x53 / IN_USE_LAST) must zero out file_size and leave filename empty (b""). Writing non-zero file sizes and filenames on chained blocks caused potential directory corruption and parsing abnormalities in BIOS and emulators. Fixed by setting file_sz = 0 and fname_bytes = b"" for middle and last blocks.
  • Dynamic Payload Expansion & Block Recalculation: When save.payload was modified to be larger after creation, build_block_data() truncated data to the old self.block_count * BLOCK_SIZE without expanding blocks, silently dropping user data. Fixed by automatically recalculating needed_blocks and updating self.block_count and self.file_size = actual_file_size on serialization.
  • Delete Safety & Infinite Loop Protection: Enhanced delete_file() with block index bounds checks (1 <= start_block <= 15), validation that start_block is an initial block (PSXBlockState.IN_USE_INITIAL), and visited cycle protection to prevent infinite loops on corrupted card directory chains.
  • Convenience Query Methods: Added get_file(filename) and has_file(filename) to PSXMemoryCard for case-insensitive save retrieval. Added regression tests in tests/test_platforms_psx_memory_card.py.
  • Sony PSP PSPRom — PBP to ISO/CSO conversion failure, raw PBP payload leak, unmounted DATA.PSAR filesystem, and substring filename matching (miorom.platforms.psp.rom):
  • PBP to ISO/CSO Conversion Failure & Raw PBP Payload Leak: In PSPRom.to_bytes(), the serializer previously assigned iso_data = bytes(self._iso.data) if self._iso else (self._pbp.to_bytes() if self._pbp else b""). When converting a PBP package to ISO (rom.to_bytes(fmt=PSPFormat.ISO)) or saving with .iso extension (rom.save("game.iso")), self._iso was None, causing to_bytes() to return self._pbp.to_bytes(). This resulted in writing raw \x00PBP container bytes into .iso files instead of an ISO 9660 filesystem, causing mounting failures in PSP emulators. Furthermore, converting a PBP to CSO compressed the PBP bytes into a corrupt CSO. Fixed by implementing _build_iso_from_pbp() to cleanly extract the embedded ISO image from DATA.PSAR or synthesize a valid ISO 9660 disc image for homebrew PBPs with DATA.PSP and metadata.
  • Unmounted Embedded ISO Filesystem in PBP: In PSPRom.__init__, loading a PBP container initialized self._pbp but never checked DATA.PSAR for an embedded ISO 9660 image, leaving self._iso None. As a result, list_files() only returned top-level PBP section names instead of virtual game assets (PSP_GAME/...), and has_file() / get_file() failed to read game files from official PSN PBP releases. Fixed by detecting ISO 9660 PVD magic (\x01CD001) in DATA.PSAR and mounting self._iso = ISO9660(psar_data).
  • Bidirectional Synchronization on Modification: Enhanced replace_file(), set_title(), set_icon(), set_background(), and set_boot_audio() to automatically update both the PBP sections and the embedded DATA.PSAR ISO image when both are active.
  • Subdirectory Filename Matching Boundary Bug: In _find_iso_file(), the search loop previously matched via f.strip("/").upper().endswith(target). In games where an asset shared a suffix with a system file (e.g. REBOOT.BIN and BOOT.BIN), _find_iso_file("BOOT.BIN") erroneously returned the wrong file. Fixed by enforcing path component boundary checks (clean_f == target or clean_f.endswith("/" + target)). Added regression tests in tests/test_platforms_psp_rom.py.
  • Sony PlayStation 1 PSXRom — Mode 1 2352-byte raw CD-ROM BIN sector misalignment, PVD sector 16 offset detection, repacking format preservation, and dynamic SYSTEM.CNF cache desync (miorom.platforms.psx.rom):
  • Mode 1 2352-Byte Sector User Data Slicing Misalignment: In _bin_to_iso_bytes(), the sector payload extraction hardcoded sec[24:2072] (which corresponds to CD-ROM XA Mode 2 Form 1 layout containing an 8-byte subheader). Raw 2352-byte Mode 1 CD-ROM images (where sec[15] == 0x01) do not possess an 8-byte subheader, and store user data at sec[16:2064]. Slicing Mode 1 BIN sectors at offset 24 shifted every sector's data by 8 bytes, corrupting the ISO 9660 filesystem image and causing ISO9660 mounting to fail (ParseError: Failed to mount PlayStation 1 ISO 9660 filesystem). Fixed by inspecting mode = sec[15] per sector and extracting sec[16:2064] for Mode 1 and sec[24:2072] for Mode 2 Form 1.
  • Mode 1 PVD Detection at Sector 16: In _detect_sector_size_and_mode(), the detector only checked sec16_off + 24 for ISO_PVD_MAGIC. In Mode 1 raw BIN images, the PVD is located at sec16_off + 16. Updated detection logic to check both sec16_off + 24 (Mode 2 Form 1) and sec16_off + 16 (Mode 1), returning (2352, 1) and setting PSXFormat.BIN_MODE1.
  • Mode 1 Packaging and Repacking: Added PSXFormat.BIN_MODE1, implemented _iso_to_bin_mode1_bytes() with sync patterns, BCD MSF headers, Mode 1 sector layout, and bit-exact 32-bit EDC checksum calculation (calculate_cdrom_edc), and updated to_bytes(), generate_cue() (TRACK 01 MODE1/2352), and save() to correctly serialize and preserve Mode 1 format.
  • Dynamic SYSTEM.CNF Cache Desynchronization: In PSXRom.replace_file(), replacing SYSTEM.CNF with updated configuration (e.g. modified boot executable or game ID) updated the virtual ISO filesystem but left self.game_id, self.boot_path, self.region, and self.system_cnf cached with stale values. Fixed by dynamically calling self._parse_system_cnf() whenever SYSTEM.CNF is replaced. Added regression tests in tests/test_platforms_psx_rom.py.
  • GameCube/Wii RVZDisc & PSP PRXModule — RVZ 4-byte padding buffer mismatch, stream resource leakage, PRX imported variables omission, and symbol name resolution (miorom.platforms.iso.rvz, miorom.platforms.psp.prx):
  • RVZ 4-Byte Buffer Padding Mismatch: In RVZDisc.create_from_stream(), the code previously attempted to pad the binary buffer to 4 bytes using bio.seek(total_rvz_size). In Python's io.BytesIO, seeking past EOF without writing does not expand the underlying buffer. Consequently, whenever the final chunk was not an exact multiple of 4 bytes, bio.getvalue() returned a buffer 1 to 3 bytes shorter than total_rvz_size, desynchronizing the file size from file_head.wia_file_size and violating Dolphin's WIA/RVZ container specification. Fixed by explicitly zero-padding bytearray(bio.getvalue()) to total_rvz_size.
  • RVZ Stream Resource Management & Hash Verification: Added close(), context manager support (__enter__ / __exit__), and is_hash_valid() to RVZDisc to verify SHA-1 checksums across file header and disc descriptor structs and prevent open file descriptor leaks.
  • PRX Imported Variables Omission & Deserialization: PRXModule._parse_imports() previously ignored stub_struct.var_count, leaving imp_lib.variables completely empty on any module importing external variables (e.g. errno, hardware registers). Fixed by parsing variable NID tables and vstub_table (present when stub_len >= 6), implementing find_import_variable(), and updating replace_import_nid() to support both functions and variables.
  • PRX Symbol Name Persistence: When finding or replacing import NIDs by symbol name, dynamically computed NIDs now register with PSPNIDResolver and persist human-readable symbol names on PRXImportFunction and PRXImportVariable instances.
  • PSP ATRAC3 / ATRAC3plus Audio Engine & Wii U8Archive — RIFF container size desync truncation, inactive cSampleLoops loop loss, negative start index crash, Extensible ATRAC3 GUID support, and U8 mapping parity (miorom.platforms.psp.at3, miorom.platforms.wii.u8):
  • RIFF Container Size Desynchronization & Audio Truncation: When set_loop(), remove_loop(), or replace_data() mutated audio.raw_data in memory, the 32-bit RIFF file size field at byte offset 4..7 and riff_header.file_size remained at their old lengths. Because AT3Audio.__init__ clips raw_data to riff_header.file_size + 8, passing audio.raw_data directly to downstream consumers or re-parsing without explicitly calling to_bytes() truncated the appended 68-byte smpl chunk or expanded audio frames. Fixed by introducing _sync_riff_size() and updating both container header bytes and riff_header.file_size automatically across all mutation methods.
  • Inactive cSampleLoops == 0 In-Place Loop Loss: When updating an existing smpl chunk that had cSampleLoops == 0 (e.g. sampler metadata without active loop points), set_loop() updated start and end offsets but left cSampleLoops at 0. Subsequent inspections or re-parses dropped loop_point because cSampleLoops < 1. Fixed by automatically updating cSampleLoops to 1 in set_loop().
  • Input Bounds Validation: Added explicit ValueError validation in set_loop() ensuring start_sample >= 0, end_sample > start_sample, and end_sample <= total_samples (when known), preventing low-level unsigned conversion errors or invalid loop points beyond the audio length.
  • WAVE_FORMAT_EXTENSIBLE ATRAC3 GUID Recognition: In _parse_format(), WAVE_FORMAT_EXTENSIBLE only checked for ATRAC3PLUS_GUID. Added recognition of the official ATRAC3 sub-format GUID ({E923AAB4-BB58-4477-AA77-03374014CD26}) to correctly identify extensible ATRAC3 streams with 1024 samples/frame.
  • Corrupt Sub-chunk Sizing Bounds Check: In _parse_chunks(), added bounds validation offset + 8 + csize <= limit to raise ParseError when a corrupted chunk header claims a size exceeding the container boundary.
  • U8Archive.get() Mapping Parity: Added .get(path, default=None) on U8Archive for consistent dictionary-like retrieval across all Nintendo archive classes.
  • Wii Riivolution Engine & WiiPartition — DolBinary missing import crash, sub-file offset redirect AttributeError, resize/create/recursive specification violations, and orig_file layout mismatch (miorom.platforms.wii.riivolution, miorom.platforms.wii.disc):
  • DolBinary Missing Import & Invalid Method Call in MemoryPatch: In apply_riivolution_to_disc(), memory patching imported from miorom.platforms.gc.dol import DolBinary. DolBinary does not exist in miorom.platforms.gc.dol (the module defines DolFile), causing an unhandled ImportError whenever applying memory patches to main.dol. Furthermore, it attempted to call dol.write_address(mem.offset, mem.value), which does not exist on either class, and completely omitted verifying mem.original bytes against current RAM before writing. Fixed by importing DolFile, verifying mem.original via dol.read_memory() prior to patching, applying writes via dol.write_memory(), and updating partition.main_dol with dol.to_bytes().
  • WiiPartition.get() Missing Dict Method & Offset Redirect Crash: When applying FileRedirect with offset > 0, apply_riivolution_to_disc() called partition.get(norm_disc_path, b""). Because WiiPartition only implemented __getitem__ without a .get() method, partial file redirections raised AttributeError: 'WiiPartition' object has no attribute 'get'. Fixed by implementing .get(path, default=None) on WiiPartition for safe dictionary-like retrieval.
  • resize="false" and create="false" Specification Compliance: apply_riivolution_to_disc() previously ignored both f_redirect.resize and f_redirect.create (as well as f_folder.create). Fixed by enforcing that create="false" redirects do not create new files on the disc, and resize="false" truncates oversized replacements or zero-pads undersized replacements to preserve original file lengths.
  • FolderRedirect.recursive="false" Traversal Bug: When recursive="false", os.walk(src_folder) previously traversed all nested subdirectories. Fixed by clearing dirnames during traversal when recursive=False, restricting folder mapping strictly to top-level files.
  • Unpacked Directory Hierarchy Asymmetry in create_riivolution_package(): When original_root unpacked assets with root/ or files/ but modified_root unpacked flat (or vice versa), orig_file = orig_path / rel_path failed to find the original file and erroneously flagged all files as newly added. Fixed by checking candidate path fallbacks (rel_path, disc_rel_path, files/disc_rel_path, root/disc_rel_path).
  • THPMovie — Stereo DSP-ADPCM audio slice desynchronization, 80-byte header omission, and max_buffer_size buffer overflow (miorom.platforms.wii.thp):
  • Stereo DSP-ADPCM Audio Header & Decoding Corruption: In authentic Nintendo GameCube & Wii THP cutscenes (e.g. Super Smash Bros Brawl, Super Mario Galaxy, The Legend of Zelda: Twilight Princess, Mario Kart Wii), audio is standard stereo (channels == 2) stored using an 80-byte (0x50) slice header (channel_size, num_samples, coefs1 [32 bytes], coefs2 [32 bytes], and 4 history samples), followed by Left ADPCM data and Right ADPCM data (channel_size * 2 bytes total). THPMovie.export_audio_wav() previously only supported a mono 44-byte (0x2C) header. On authentic stereo cutscenes, it sliced audio starting from offset 44 (which contains Channel 2 coefficients and history samples), interpreting predictor coefficients as compressed ADPCM and corrupting the beginning of every frame with loud screeching noise, while completely dropping Channel 2. Furthermore, set_audio_wav() forcibly downmixed stereo audio to mono. Fixed by implementing THPStereoAudioFrameHeaderStruct (80 bytes), demuxing and decoding both Left and Right channels with their respective coefficient tables in export_audio_wav(), and preserving/encoding true stereo audio in set_audio_wav().
  • max_buffer_size Frame Header Sizing & Console Buffer Overflow: In THPMovie.to_bytes(), buf_size was previously computed as len(f.image_data) + len(f.audio_data), omitting the 16-byte THPFrameHeaderStruct. According to the Nintendo THP format specification and DVD streaming architecture, max_buffer_size specifies the maximum buffer in bytes required to store one complete frame slice (header + video + audio) allocated in console memory by THPPlayerInit. Omitting the 16 bytes produced undersized buffer allocations resulting in 16-byte buffer overflows on console hardware. Fixed by computing buf_size = THPFrameHeaderStruct.sizeof() + len(f.image_data) + len(f.audio_data) (i.e. max(frame_sizes)). Added regression tests in tests/test_platforms_wii_thp.py.
  • BNS Audio Engine — authentic codec 0 DSP-ADPCM silent decode fallback & Channel Info 12-byte struct layout desynchronization (miorom.platforms.wii.banner):
  • Authentic Codec 0 Discarding Audio: In authentic Nintendo BNS (Banner Nintendo Sound) files across all official Wii titles, the codec field at offset 0 of the INFO chunk is 0 (denoting standard DSP-ADPCM), whereas extended format variants occasionally use 2. decode_bns_to_wav() previously checked only elif codec == 2:, falling through to the else: branch which synthesized 1000 samples of silence. When reading opening banner sounds from retail Wii discs, all audio was discarded. Fixed by recognizing both standard 0 and 2 as DSP-ADPCM.
  • Channel Info 12-Byte Descriptor & DSP Coefficient Offset Desync: In the Nintendo BNS format specification (and standard decoders such as vgmstream), the Channel Info Pointer Table at offset 0x18 points to 12-byte Channel Info descriptors (channel_data_offset, channel_dsp_offset, reserved=0). encode_wav_to_bns() previously omitted the 12-byte Channel Info descriptors and placed raw coefficient blocks directly, while writing hardcoded offsets that were shifted by 4 bytes on mono streams. When parsed by standard decoders like vgmstream, this caused immediate parsing failures or misaligned DSP predictor coefficients. Furthermore, decode_bns_to_wav() hardcoded coefficient lookups to 0x20 + ch * 0x30 without following the Channel Info pointer table. Fixed by formatting full 12-byte Channel Info structures in encode_wav_to_bns() with codec = 0, and dynamically parsing channel_data_offset and channel_dsp_offset from the pointer table in decode_bns_to_wav(). Added regression tests in tests/test_platforms_wii_banner.py.
  • NDSBanner & extract_rom — DSi Extended Animated Icon offset misalignment, missing crc_dsi calculation/validation, zero-dependency PNG export/injection, and ROM banner truncation (miorom.platforms.nds.banner, miorom.platforms.nds.rom):
  • DSi Animated Icon Offset Misalignment & Missing Padding: In the Nintendo DS/DSi cartridge banner container specification (Version 0x0103), the DSi animated icon payload (0x1180 = 4480 bytes) is located at offset 0x1240..0x23BF (total container size 0x23C0 / 9152 bytes), preceded by 0x800 bytes (2048 bytes) of reserved zero-filled padding at 0x0A40..0x123F. NDSBanner.to_bytes() previously appended dsi_extended_data immediately at 0x0A40 without the 0x800 bytes of zeros, shifting the animation payload 2048 bytes too early (yielding 0x1BC0 bytes) and breaking DSi firmware compatibility. In from_bytes(), reading authentic 0x23C0 DSi banners sliced from 0x0A40:, capturing 6528 bytes (including the 0x800 zero padding) into dsi_extended_data. Fixed by padding to offset 0x1240 and 0x23C0 in to_bytes(), and cleanly extracting 0x1240:0x23C0 (4480 bytes) in from_bytes() while maintaining backward compatibility for legacy/unpadded buffers.
  • Missing crc_dsi Checksum Calculation & Validation: header.crc_dsi (covering 0x1240..0x23BF, 0x1180 bytes) was previously ignored during to_bytes(recalc_crc=True) (remaining 0) and is_crc_valid() never verified crc_dsi. Fixed by computing RetroChecksum.crc16_modbus across the 0x1180 DSi payload during serialization and validating it in is_crc_valid() for Version 0x0103 banners.
  • Zero-Dependency PNG Export & Injection: Added to_png_bytes() and save_icon_png(path) to NDSBanner using the pure-Python standard-library PNGCodec, and enhanced set_image() to accept PNG binary bytes, PNGImage, and PNG file paths without requiring Pillow.
  • ROM Extraction Banner Truncation: extract_rom in miorom.platforms.nds.rom previously extracted a hardcoded 0x840 bytes for banner.bin, truncating v2 (0x940), v3 (0xA40), and DSi (0x23C0) banners. Fixed by inspecting the banner version to extract the full container size. Added regression tests in tests/test_platforms_nds_banner.py.
  • BRSTMFile — HEAD Part 1 0x34-byte sizing, missing final_block_padded_size, and relative audio offset desynchronization (miorom.platforms.wii.brstm):
  • 0x34-Byte HEAD Part 1 Structure & Missing final_block_padded_size: BRSTMHeadPart1Struct was previously defined as 0x30 bytes (48 bytes) instead of the standard 0x34 bytes (52 bytes) specified by the Nintendo Wii SDK and format specifications. The 4-byte final_block_padded_size field at offset 0x28 was omitted, causing samples_per_seek (0x2C) and seek_entries_per_block (0x30) to shift backwards into offset 0x28 and 0x2C, and truncating Part 1 by 4 bytes. In to_bytes(), this shifted Part 2 (p2_off) and Part 3 (p3_off) offsets by 4 bytes (e.g. p2_off = 0x44 instead of 0x48), producing non-standard BRSTM files that failed on hardware and third-party tools. In from_bytes(), authentic BRSTMs suffered field corruption and could not read final_block_padded_size.
  • Absolute vs Relative audio_data_offset: In to_bytes(), audio_data_offset was hardcoded to 0x20 instead of the absolute file offset data_offset + 0x20. On Wii hardware and decoders like vgmstream that rely on audio_data_offset as an absolute seek target from file start, this caused DMA to stream from offset 0x20 (the RSTM header), resulting in static noise or crashes. In from_bytes(), reading authentic BRSTMs where audio_data_offset >= data_offset mistakenly added data_off + p1.audio_data_offset, doubling the offset and skipping past the audio stream. Fixed by adding final_block_padded_size at offset 0x28, aligning Part 1/2/3 offsets to 0x34 bytes, computing absolute audio_data_offset = data_offset + 0x20 in to_bytes(), and handling both absolute and relative audio offsets in from_bytes(). Added regression tests in tests/test_platforms_wii_brstm.py.
  • MSBFFile — UTF-8 encoding corruption on Big-Endian archives & ChoiceNode options crosstalk (miorom.text.msbf):
  • UTF-8 on Big-Endian Corruption: In to_bytes(), the codec ternary operator "utf-16-be" if used_endian == ">" else "utf-16-le" if enc_code == 1 else "utf-8" evaluated used_endian == ">" first, forcing "utf-16-be" for all Big-Endian archives (Nintendo Wii/GameCube standard) even when encoding == "utf-8", while appending a single-byte 0x00 null terminator. In from_bytes(), the same operator precedence bug forced "utf-16-be" decode while scanning for single-byte 0x00, causing the parser to match the high zero byte of the first character, cutting options to empty strings "" or corrupting byte alignment.
  • ChoiceNode Options Crosstalk: In to_bytes(), FLW3NodeStruct.param1 was hardcoded to 0 instead of recording the option offset len(all_options), and in from_bytes(), every ChoiceNode sliced option_strings[:branch_count] starting at index 0, causing all choice nodes across a dialogue tree to inherit the options of the very first choice node. Fixed by correcting the codec selection to ("utf-16-be" if endian == ">" else "utf-16-le") if encoding == "utf-16" else "utf-8", scanning 2-byte aligned \x00\x00 terminators in UTF-16, and properly indexing/tracking option offsets across ChoiceNodes. Added regression tests in tests/test_text_msbf.py.
  • BRSARSoundArchive.to_bytes — sparse & non-contiguous file_id table index desynchronization (miorom.platforms.wii.brsar): BRSARSoundArchive.to_bytes() previously compacted the INFO File Table by iterating only over sorted(self._files.keys()) and emitting len(self._files) entries, while writing the raw original s.file_id into the Sound Table without index remapping. In authentic Wii BRSAR archives where sounds reference non-contiguous or sparse file IDs (e.g. following RBNK/RSEQ entries), s.file_id exceeded the truncated File Table length, causing re-parsed sound entries to receive zero sizes/offsets and shifting file storage keys in self._files, leading to immediate ValueError: No file payload found errors during export_wav(). Fixed by structuring the File Table to accommodate all file IDs up to max_f_id with 1:1 index-to-file_id correspondence, emitting empty (0, 0) descriptors for unreferenced slots, and safely ignoring zero-length entries during re-parsing. Added regression test in tests/test_platforms_wii_brsar.py.
  • PointerRelinker._measure_slot & find_free_space — unbounded scan, adjacent string corruption & protected range collision (miorom.text.pointer_relinker): PointerRelinker._measure_slot() previously scanned forward until hitting fill_byte without bounding against the next pointer target or null delimiters (0x00). In tightly-packed string tables (where no fill byte separates consecutive strings) or in ROMs without fill_byte padding, _measure_slot() scanned through adjacent strings and data all the way to the end of the ROM. When relinking with a shortened string, the calculated tail padded with fill_byte across the unbounded range, wiping out subsequent strings, pointer targets, and ROM memory. Furthermore, find_free_space() did not avoid active pointer tables or previously allocated free-space blocks, allowing relocated strings to clobber table structures. Fixed by: (1) adding max_bound to _measure_slot() constrained by subsequent pointer targets and allocated boundaries; (2) terminating slot measurement on 0x00 (when fill_byte != 0); and (3) adding exclude_ranges to find_free_space() to ensure free space runs never overlap pointer table entries or active allocations. Added regression tests in tests/test_text_pointer_relinker.py.
  • BranchRelocator.patch_single_branch & rebase_block — MIPS little-endian & architecture support (miorom.asm.reloc_calc) (BUG-59): Fixed hardcoded Big-Endian >I packing and unpacking in MIPS branch patching which corrupted branch opcodes and displacements on Little-Endian MIPS platforms (Sony PlayStation 1 / R3000A and Sony PSP / Allegrex). Added endian parameter ("little", "big", "<", ">") defaulting to Little-Endian for psx, psp, mips_le, and mips, and Big-Endian for n64 and mips_be. Furthermore, implemented complete MIPS branch scanning and rebasing in BranchRelocator.rebase_block() supporting standard conditional branches (BEQ, BNE, BLEZ, BGTZ), REGIMM branches (BLTZ, BGEZ, BLTZAL, BGEZAL), and Branch Likely instructions (BEQL, BNEL, BLEZL, BGTZL).
  • pack_both_u16 & pack_both_u32 — both-endian field byte-swapping (miorom.platforms.iso.builder): Fixed a standard-compliance bug in ISO 9660 (ECMA-119 Section 7.2.3 & 7.3.3) both-byte order serialization where pack_both_u16() and pack_both_u32() used schema.pack("<HH", val, val) and schema.pack("<II", val, val). Because <HH and <II format strings apply little-endian encoding to both arguments, the big-endian half of all Primary Volume Descriptor fields (volume_space_size, logical_block_size, volume_sequence_number, path_table_size) and all Directory Record fields (lba, size, volume_sequence_number) was byte-swapped into little-endian. Big-endian readers and standards validators reading big-endian fields saw completely corrupted sector numbers (e.g., LBA 20 decoded as sector 335,544,320; block size 2048 decoded as 8). Corrected to serialize with <H + >H and <I + >I, ensuring bit-exact ECMA-119 both-byte order compliance.
  • MSBFFile — big-endian struct header & node deserialization/serialization desync (miorom.text.msbf): MSBFFile.from_bytes() and .to_bytes() previously invoked MSBFHeaderStruct, MSBFSectionHeaderStruct, FLW3HeaderStruct, and FLW3NodeStruct .from_bytes() and .to_bytes() without passing endian=endian / endian=used_endian. Because BinaryStruct defaults to Little-Endian ("<"), authentic Big-Endian Nintendo Wii MSBF files (b"\xFE\xFF") had section sizes decoded as byte-swapped integers (e.g. 24 bytes became 402 MB), skipping all subsequent sections (FEN1, FOP1), while node descriptors had node_type byte-swapped (type 1 became 256), breaking node classification. In .to_bytes(), serializing with endian=">" produced corrupt hybrid binaries with little-endian struct headers and big-endian payloads. Fixed by explicitly threading endianness through all BinaryStruct from_bytes/to_bytes invocations across MSBFFile.
  • OverlayRegion & MemoryOverlayMapper — linear address translation performed on compressed overlays (miorom.core.overlay_mapper): OverlayRegion.ram_to_rom() and rom_to_ram() previously ignored the overlay flags field (bit 24 indicating LZ10/BLZ compression status) and blindly applied linear delta arithmetic, returning meaningless addresses for compressed overlays whose physical ROM bytes do not correlate 1:1 to RAM. Added compression validation returning None by default (with optional raise_on_compressed=True raising CompressedOverlayError) and documenting that overlays must be decompressed prior to mapping offsets in decompressed memory.
  • MemoryOverlayMapper.detect_dma_copies — empty stub and lack of GBA DMA3 transfer detection (miorom.core.overlay_mapper): The heuristic scanner for GBA DMA3 transfers previously matched the literal register address 0x040000D4 but was an empty stub (pass), always returning an empty list. Implemented complete ARM and Thumb heuristic scanning using UniversalDisassembler to disassemble candidate code windows, perform register state tracking and traceback to literal pool LDRs / immediates, correlate sequential stores to 0x040000D4 (DMA3SAD), 0x040000D8 (DMA3DAD), and 0x040000DC (DMA3CNT), and construct valid DMACopyRecord instances with accurate pc_address, source_address, destination_address, and word_count (lower 16-bit count from DMA3CNT).
  • interleave_smd — non-16KB chunk zero-padding (miorom.platforms.md.rom) (BUG-89): Non-16KB-aligned Sega Genesis ROMs are now zero-padded to the next 16KB boundary before interleaving into Super Magic Drive format to prevent payload corruption.
  • RomIntegrityManager.fix — preservation of SMD container format (miorom.core.integrity) (BUG-91): Auto-fixing Mega Drive ROM checksums now correctly checks if the input was SMD format and re-interleaves back into SMD before returning.
  • MSBTFile.from_bytes — invalid string offset alignment preservation (miorom.text.msbt) (BUG-92): Invalid out-of-bounds string offsets now fallback to empty strings instead of desynchronizing the label-to-message mapping.
  • MSBTFile — control tag null bytes string truncation (miorom.text.msbt) (BUG-93): Control tags (0x000E) containing null bytes in their argument payloads now properly advance the parser position without truncating the message text.
  • GBASavePatcher.patch_to_sram — 7-byte FLASH_V string replacement (miorom.save.gba_save) (BUG-94): Replaced 7-byte b"FLASH_V" with 7-byte b"SRAM_V\x00" instead of 6-byte b"SRAM_V", avoiding trailing phantom characters in patched ROM headers.
  • PlanarTileCodec — SNES Mode 7 linear chunky encoding (miorom.graphics.planar) (BUG-95): Mapped Mode 7 tiles to linear chunky 8bpp format rather than bitplane planar formats.
  • MDECVideoDecoder — 0xFE00 EOB token draining & chroma quantization (miorom.graphics.mdec) (BUG-96, BUG-97): Correctly drains trailing 0xFE00 EOB marker on coefficient overflow and added support for custom chroma quantization tables.
  • PPFPatcher.apply_stream — truncated target image rejection (miorom.patch.ppf) (BUG-98): Rejects target images smaller than the required validation block offset when non-dummy validation blocks are present.
  • BMFont.to_bitmap_font — unicode code point bounds check (miorom.text.bmfont) (BUG-99): Wrapped character conversion with validation to prevent unhandled ValueError when glyph IDs exceed 0x10FFFF.
  • BMGFile.from_bytes — string pool offset bounds checking (miorom.text.bmg) (BUG-100): Out-of-bounds DAT1 message offsets are safely caught and assigned empty strings.
  • BRRCodec.encode_block — shift selector middle range threshold (miorom.audio.brr) (BUG-101): Lowered shift threshold from max_res > 7 to max_res > 3 to eliminate clipping in small-amplitude audio samples.
  • SDATContainer.to_bytes — empty SYMB block INFO offset & FAT header count (miorom.audio.sdat) (BUG-102, BUG-103): Fixed INFO block offset to start at 64 when SYMB is absent, and ensured the FAT block header count reflects the total entry count.
  • SappyCodec.parse_sample — fixed-point 10-bit pitch conversion (miorom.audio.sappy) (BUG-104): Corrected sample rate calculation to divide fixed-point pitch by 1024 (pitch >> 10).
  • VAGCodec.encode — SPU-ADPCM shift filter direction (miorom.audio.vag) (BUG-105): Inverted shift search order to select optimal scaling factors starting from smallest scale (12) down to 0.
  • XAStreamDecoder.decode_sector — continuous filter state across sound units (miorom.audio.xa) (BUG-106): Sequential sound units now preserve filter prediction history across sound units within CD-XA sectors.
  • Elf32RelaStruct — signed relocation addend packing (miorom.link.elf) (BUG-107): Packed r_addend as signed 32-bit integer (I32) to properly support negative relocation addends.
  • PatternScanner.iter_file — overlapping chunk duplicate prevention (miorom.scanner.pattern) (BUG-108): Tracks maximum yielded offset to prevent duplicate matches across sliding buffer windows.
  • DeepScanner.scan — trailing partial block entropy averaging & NARC BOM endianness (miorom.scanner.deep) (BUG-109, BUG-110): Counts exact processed blocks in Shannon entropy calculation and properly resolves BOM endianness (0xFEFF vs 0xFFFE).
  • DolBinary.__init__ — immutable bytes input conversion (miorom.link.dol) (BUG-111): Wraps binary input in bytearray() to prevent TypeError when modifying sections in-place.
  • CascadingArchive.unpack — bounded entry count validation (miorom.archive.cascading) (BUG-112): Validates declared entry count against payload length before allocating memory buffers.
  • LZ10.compress & LZ11.compress — sliding window rfind upper bound allows forward self-reference (miorom.compression.lz10, miorom.compression.lz11): The lookahead match search previously used search_pos + 3 as the rfind upper boundary, allowing matches starting ahead of search_pos to produce zero or negative displacement backreferences, causing decompressors to fail with CompressionError: invalid displacement. Fixed boundary to search_pos + 1 and constrained lookahead extension to pos + match_len < in_pos.
  • APLib._BitWriter.put_gamma — zero bit emission on unit value (miorom.compression.aplib): Variable-length gamma coding for val <= 1 executed 0 loop iterations in while temp > 1, emitting 0 bits and corrupting all downstream bitstreams. Added explicit base-case check emitting a single 0 terminator bit for val <= 1. Also expanded maximum sliding window lookback from 32,000 to standard 32,767 (0x7FFF) bytes.
  • RLE.compress — off-by-one run length cap & unhandled end marker (miorom.compression.rle): Corrected maximum compressed run-length condition to run_len < (0x7F + 3) (max 130 bytes). Previously, run_len < (0x7F + 4) allowed runs up to 131 bytes, where run_len - 3 = 128 = 0x80 overflowed the 7-bit length field and zeroed it via 0x80 | 0x80, causing decompression to truncate data. Additionally implemented include_end_marker behavior to emit END_OF_STREAM (0xFF) when requested. Added regression tests for 130, 131, and 262 bytes and randomized roundtrip fuzzing in tests/test_rle.py.
  • BinaryLifter.lift — conditional branch CFG fall-through edge omission (miorom.script.lifter): BinaryLifter ignored is_conditional=True on conditional branch instructions (beq, bne, bc, bgt, etc.), emitting only a single successor edge to the taken branch target and omitting the fall-through edge. This caused fall-through blocks to become orphan nodes with empty predecessors (predecessors: []), broke CFG topology, distorted cyclomatic complexity calculations ($E - V + 2$) in BinDiffEngine, and broke decompiler control flow. Fixed by emitting both branch-taken and fall-through successor edges for IROp.BRANCH_COND instructions, maintaining bidirectional predecessor/successor links, and properly connecting non-branch/non-return block terminations to sequential fall-through leaders.
  • IROp.CMP & Comparison Instruction Lowering (miorom.script.ir, miorom.script.lifter): Comparison instructions (cmp, cmn, tst, teq, cmpw, cmpwi, cmplw, cmplwi, cp, etc.) across ARM/Thumb, PowerPC, M68K, 6502/65816, and SM83 were previously dropped or lowered to NOP(), losing operands. Added IROp.CMP opcode to IROp, preserved comparison operands, and synthesized relational condition expressions (e.g. r0 == 0) for subsequent conditional branches and C decompilation (if (r0 == 0) goto ...;).
  • _disasm_arm — ARM conditional branch mnemonic condition suffixes (miorom.asm.disasm): ARM 32-bit branch instructions with condition codes (cond < 14) emitted bare "b" / "bl" mnemonics despite is_conditional=True. Added condition code suffix formatting (beq, bne, ble, bgt, blt, etc.) matching standard ARM disassembly and ensuring lifter pattern matching correctly distinguishes conditional branches from unconditional jumps.
  • BinaryLifter.convert_to_ssa — condition expressions wrapped into IRVar (miorom.script.lifter): convert_to_ssa matched register names using a.startswith("r"), incorrectly converting expression strings like "r0 == 0" into IRVar(name="r0 == 0", version=0). Refined register recognition with _is_reg to accurately identify register tokens (r0..r31, $a0, d0..d7, a, x, y, sp, lr, pc) without mangling condition expressions.
  • StructProfiler.profile_struct — field boundary and width heuristic desynchronization (miorom.core.struct_profiler): Fixed a major heuristic flaw where 4-byte fields were only accepted as UINT32 when max_val > 0xFFFF. Small 32-bit values (such as IDs or counters in 0..0xFFFF) previously fell through to 2-byte analysis without advancing col += 4, permanently desynchronizing all subsequent field offsets. Replaced the simplistic max_val > 0xFFFF check with 4-byte natural alignment checks (stride % 4 != 0 or col % 4 == 0) and independent half-word variance/delta analysis (is_split_16), accurately distinguishing true 32-bit fields from adjacent 16-bit fields (e.g. <IHHI). Added comprehensive regression tests in tests/test_struct_profiler.py.
  • StructProfiler.profile_struct — API composability and StrideCandidate auto-unwrapping (miorom.core.struct_profiler): profile_struct() now accepts Union[int, StrideCandidate, List[StrideCandidate]], allowing direct pipelining of autodetect_stride() candidate results into profile_struct(data, candidates) without raising TypeError. Empty lists, invalid types, and non-positive strides now raise clear, descriptive ValueError and TypeError exceptions.
  • Huffman.compress & Huffman.decompress — empty input (b"") roundtrip support (miorom.compression.huffman): Compressing empty data previously returned a truncated 6-byte stream (28 00 00 00 00 00) missing the required 2-byte tree table placeholder ((tree_size_code + 1) * 2 = 2), causing decompress() to fail with Malformed Huffman tree: extends beyond input data. Updated compress() to emit a valid 7-byte header with a 2-byte tree placeholder (b"\x00\x00"), and updated decompress() to early-return b"" when uncompressed_size == 0. Added regression tests in tests/test_huffman.py.
  • calc_mips_jump & _disasm_mips — 256MB segment validation and delay-slot base address (miorom.asm.branch, miorom.asm.disasm): Added optional src_addr parameter to calc_mips_jump() with upper 4-bit segment checking against the delay slot PC (src_addr + 4), preventing invalid cross-segment jumps. Fixed MIPS J/JAL target address reconstruction in UniversalDisassembler to calculate upper bits from (address + 4) & 0xF0000000.
  • BranchRelocator.rebase_block & TrampolineHook — out-of-range ARM branch protection & 6502 16-bit address guard (miorom.asm.reloc_calc, miorom.asm.trampoline): ARM branch rebasing in rebase_block() now checks item.in_range before writing rebased instruction bytes to avoid corrupting out-of-range branches. Added explicit bounds checking to TrampolineHook.create_6502_hook() to ensure cave_ram_addr <= 0xFFFF before packing 16-bit JMP targets. Documented architectural limitations regarding PC-relative displaced instructions in ARM, Thumb, and PowerPC trampolines.
  • NDSRom.replace_file & get_banner_title — FAT table shift tracking & UTF-16-LE alignment (miorom.platforms.nds.rom): Replacing ROM files with larger data buffers shifted the underlying bytearray but left self.fat_offset and downstream FAT record pointers pointing to pre-shift locations, corrupting FAT tables. Updated replace_file() to adjust self.fat_offset when the FAT resides after the replaced region. Fixed banner title string truncation to align down to even boundaries (null_pos - (null_pos % 2)) to avoid corrupting UTF-16-LE character pairs.
  • NARCFile._parse_btnf_names & PSXSaveHeaderStruct — flat-file BTNF name parsing & save title field bounds (miorom.platforms.nds.narc, miorom.platforms.psx.memory_card): Implemented flat-file BTNF name table parsing in NARCFile so extracted files retain real filenames instead of generic numbers. Partitioned PSXSaveHeaderStruct title field into 32-byte Shift-JIS title and 32-byte reserved padding, preventing garbage characters in parsed save titles.
  • VFSFile.truncate & IPS32 Truncation Guard (miorom.archive.vfs, miorom.patch.ips): Implemented missing VFSFile.truncate(size=0) method to prevent AttributeError crashes when opening existing virtual files in write mode. In IpsPatcher.apply(), guarded trailing IPS32 truncation sizes with 0 < trunc_size < len(result) to prevent trailing archive padding from wiping patched buffers.
  • SSEQSequence & SSEQTrack — MIDI transpiler delta-times, loop preservation & tempo endianness (miorom.audio.sseq): Fixed opcode 0xE0 tempo decoding from big-endian to little-endian (<H). Implemented two-pass loop compilation in _compile_track_events() so loop_start and loop_end markers emit compliant 0x94 jumps instead of being silently dropped. Added individual 0-tick VLQ delta times between consecutive RPN CC messages (CC101, CC100, CC6, CC38) for pitch bend range in MIDI output. Replaced fragile dummy-event RPN detection in from_midi() with persistent track-level state variables.
  • ScriptVM & BytecodeStreamSplicer — signed integer argument emission & relative branch counts (miorom.script.vm, miorom.script.splicer): Assembler Pass 2 now handles s8, s16, and s32 argument types without silently dropping operands. In BytecodeStreamSplicer.splice_and_shift(), restricted operand repacking and adjusted_count increments to branches that actually cross the splice boundary.
  • PointerRelinker & StringTablePipeline — banked pointer table scanning & signed relative pointer extraction (miorom.text.pointer_relinker, miorom.text.pipeline): Added bank_table: Optional[List[int]] parameter to PointerRelinker.scan_pointer_table() to properly map per-entry bank numbers in banked pointer tables. Added two's-complement sign extension to raw_ptr in StringTablePipeline.extract_strings() when is_relative=True, restoring extraction of backward-relative script pointers.
  • KosinskiCodec.compress — descriptor high-byte truncation (miorom.compression.kosinski): Flushing the final descriptor word omitted writing out[desc_pos + 1] = (val >> 8) & 0xFF. For inputs where remaining descriptor bits exceeded 8 bits, bits 8..15 were zeroed, causing the decompressor to misinterpret literal bytes as invalid backreferences and fail with CompressionError. Fixed by writing both descriptor bytes during finalization.
  • BpsPatcher.parse — null-byte dropping and linear overhead in expanded ROMs (miorom.patch.bps): Converting BPS patches into concrete PatchHunk records filtered expanded ROM bytes using if byte:, silently omitting all 0x00 bytes in target expansion areas. Replaced byte-by-byte iteration with unified slice hunk emission (PatchHunk(source_len, output[source_len:])), preserving all data bytes and accelerating parsing from $O(N)$ to $O(1)$.
  • BranchRelocator — missing second-halfword validation for Thumb BL (miorom.asm.reloc_calc): Re-basing Thumb branch instructions unpacked the second halfword into raw_val2 but never verified the prefix/suffix match (raw_val2 & 0xF800) == 0xF800.   • PowerPCBranch.encode_b — out-of-range absolute branch silent truncation (miorom.asm.branch): Boundary checks for PowerPC branch encoding explicitly bypassed absolute branches (if not absolute).   • cmd_disasm — UniversalDisassembler calls undefined disassemble_stream (miorom.cli.main): Executing the miorom disasm CLI command on non-m68k architectures crashed with an AttributeError because it called disassemble_stream.   • cmd_scan_text — TranslationRow instantiated with unexpected length argument (miorom.cli.main): Exporting scanned dialogue strings to a CSV file (miorom scan-text --output) threw a TypeError due to an unexpected length keyword argument being passed to TranslationRow.   • ROM Handler — GBRom property typo cartridge_type_name (miorom.rom.handlers.cartridge): Processing Game Boy ROMs through the universal ROM handler triggered an AttributeError because it attempted to access .cartridge_type_name instead of the actual .cartridge_type property.   • LZExtendedSizeStruct & RLEExtendedSizeStruct — missing definitions and imports for extended sizes (miorom.compression.lz11, miorom.compression.rle): Decompressing large LZ11 or RLE streams (> 0xFFFFFF bytes or 0-size fallback) triggered fatal NameError exceptions due to missing struct definitions and imports. Added missing imports and defined RLEExtendedSizeStruct locally in rle.py to restore extended size support.
  • ExtractArchiveStep & PackArchiveStep — mismatched U8Archive classmethod signatures (miorom.pipeline.engine): The pipeline engine incorrectly called non-existent U8Archive.from_bytes() and from_directory() methods, crashing during U8 archive tasks. Fixed by using the correct U8Archive.extract_all() and U8Archive.pack() API methods.
  • LiteralRelocator — scan_all method missing from UniversalInstructionScanner (miorom.asm.literal_relocator): The universal fallback path for literal relocation called an undefined scan_all method. Replaced with the correct find_code_pointers method and updated the data argument to code.
  • table_detector — unreachable code and undefined variables (miorom.scanner.table_detector): The extract_strings method contained a leftover, unreachable return extracted statement after a valid list return. Cleaned up the dead code.
  • Missing Domain Exceptions and Typing Imports (miorom.*): Standard domain exceptions (ParseError, RelocationError) and typing hints (List, Tuple, Any, Sequence) were omitted from imports in several modules (e.g. expander.py, tilesheet.py, vm.py, vwf.py, heap.py, ncgr.py, sfo.py, u8.py), masking underlying parsing errors as fatal NameError exceptions. Injected all missing top-level module imports to restore correct error propagation and type resolution.
  • AutoRelocationManager — relative pointer arithmetic inverted (miorom.patch.relocator): read_pointer_value and write_pointer_value previously calculated relative targets using base_address + raw_val and new_target_offset - base_address. Fixed to compute relative targets from the pointer's own buffer location (pointer_offset + raw_val and new_target_offset - pointer_offset) with signed delta support.
  • PointerRelinker.relink — free-space search colliding with pointer tables (miorom.text.pointer_relinker): In ROMs filled with the designated fill byte (e.g. 0xFF), find_free_space() could allocate memory inside the pointer table range, corrupting subsequent pointers during batch relinking. Added protected_ranges support to guarantee free-space runs never overlap pointer tables or active allocations.
  • DialogueDissector.extract_from_table — target offset calculation ignores pointer_type (miorom.script.dialogue_dissector): Hardcoded subtraction of base_address broke relative and banked pointer tables. Added pointer_type and bank parameters to extract_from_table and delegated offset resolution to PointerRelinker._to_rom_offset().
  • DialogueDissector.inject_translations — relocation pointer rewrite uses absolute arithmetic (miorom.script.dialogue_dissector): Relocated string pointers were rewritten using allocated_off + block.base_address regardless of addressing mode. Now delegates to relinker._to_pointer_value(allocated_off, pointer_type, bank) to properly format relative and banked pointer updates.
  • SmartScriptRepacker.repack_with_translations — label drift on unknown multi-byte opcodes (miorom.script.repacker): Unregistered instructions with raw multi-byte payloads were sized as single-byte instructions during Pass 1, skewing subsequent branch label offsets. Sizing and emission now account for raw_bytes payloads.
  • SmartAutoPaginator.paginate_text — manual newlines collapsed inside paragraphs (miorom.text.paginator): Splitting text with whitespace-collapsing .split() stripped explicit \n linebreaks chosen by translators. Updated to process paragraph lines independently and preserve hard line breaks.
  • find_pane — NUL-padded pane name matching failure (miorom.platforms.wii.brlyt): Comparing 16-byte fixed-string pane names directly failed when entries contained trailing NUL padding. Now strips trailing \x00 characters from both search target and candidate names.
  • apply_vertical_gradient — missing buffer validation (miorom.graphics.pixel_math): Added buffer length validation ensuring mask_bytes matches expected 8-bit mask or 32-bit RGBA dimensions, and documented source alpha channel modulation behavior.
  • VWFHookEngine.synthesize_width_routine — Thumb routine jumps into 32-bit literal pool (miorom.asm.vwf_hook_engine): In 16-bit Thumb mode, B .done branched directly to offset 0x10 where table_vaddr was stored as raw 32-bit data, causing the processor to execute address bytes as instructions. Updated routine layout to branch cleanly over the 4-byte literal pool (B .after_pool) to offset 0x18, loading via PC-relative LDR r2, [PC, #12] with proper 4-byte boundary alignment.
  • DynamicVWFInjector.generate_arm_vwf_hook & generate_mips_vwf_hook — premature return inside trampoline caves (miorom.text.vwf_injector): Embedding generated ARM and MIPS lookup routines into TrampolineHook's inline cave payload caused premature subroutine returns (BX lr / jr $ra; nop) before displaced instructions and trampoline return branches could execute. Added standalone: bool = True parameter (defaulting False in VWFHookEngine.synthesize_width_routine) to generate inline fall-through variants that branch over literal pools directly to the cave tail.
  • ThumbBranch.encode_b — missing 11-bit branch range check (miorom.asm.branch): Unconditional 16-bit Thumb B instructions have an 11-bit signed halfword displacement ([-2048, 2046] bytes). Target offsets exceeding this limit were silently masked via & 0x7FF, generating branches to corrupted addresses. Added range check raising RelocationError on overflow, along with decode_b() and decode_bl() decoding helpers.
  • Yaz0.compress — lookback window unbounded by MAX_DIST (miorom.compression.yaz0): When search_depth exceeded MAX_DIST (4096 bytes), start_window lookback calculation allowed match distances greater than 4096, which overflowed the 12-bit distance field and corrupted compressed output. Capped start_window to src_pos - min(src_pos, min(search_depth, MAX_DIST)).
  • DteCodec.encode — unmapped Unicode characters silently truncated (miorom.text.dte): Non-ASCII Unicode characters unmapped by the provided charmap or without a charmap were truncated to 8 bits via ord(ch) & 0xFF, silently altering characters into unrelated ASCII codes. Now raises ValueError when ord(ch) > 0xFF.
  • JapaneseCharMapMiner.search_kana_word — 2-byte search skips unaligned ROM offsets (miorom.text.japanese_charmap): In 2-byte search mode, candidate positions stepped by 2 bytes, missing 16-bit Japanese character sequences located at odd byte offsets (e.g. following 1-byte command opcodes). Updated search to advance by 1 byte.
  • TagSyntaxValidator.validate & TagManager.decode_tags — bracket ordering ignored and escaped newlines conflated (miorom.text.tags): TagSyntaxValidator.validate relied on simple bracket counts, incorrectly validating reversed (]...[) and nested ([[...]]) brackets; replaced with a bracket stack validator. TagManager.decode_tags previously replaced literal \\n with <ENTER>, destroying escaped strings; made escaped newline conversion optional via convert_escaped_newlines: bool = False.
  • AFSArchive — hardcoded ASCII encoding corrupts Japanese TOC filenames (miorom.archive.afs): TOC filenames in CRI AFS archives were strictly decoded and encoded using ASCII, replacing Shift-JIS / CP932 characters common in Dreamcast, Saturn, and PS2 titles with replacement characters. Added encoding: str = "cp932" support to __init__, from_bytes(), and to_bytes() with automatic fallback.

docs.title: Fixed
docs.text:
• ScriptVMDissector.splice_and_relink — branch operand offset off by base_offset (miorom.script.script_dissector): All branch operand write positions were computed as absolute ROM offsets, but new_buf is a 0-indexed local script slice. Every branch in a script not at ROM offset 0 was written to the wrong position. Fixed: all op_pos values now subtract script.base_offset before indexing into new_buf.
  • ScriptVMDissector.splice_and_relink — return value is a script slice, not a full ROM buffer (miorom.script.script_dissector): Callers assigning the return value directly to rom[:] would silently truncate the ROM. Docstring now explicitly documents the splice contract and the correct pattern: rom[base_offset : base_offset + len(new_script)] = new_script.
  • ScriptVMDissector.splice_and_relink — length-prefix overflow raises generic error (miorom.script.script_dissector): For has_length_prefix=True instructions, translations longer than 255 encoded bytes raised a bare ValueError from bytearray.append() with no indication of which instruction caused it. Now raises an explicit ValueError with the instruction index, ROM offset, and byte count.
  • StringTablePipeline.extract_strings — is_relative=True pointer arithmetic inverted (miorom.text.pipeline): The formula base_address + raw_ptr was used for relative pointers, which is incorrect. A relative pointer is an offset from the pointer's own ROM location; the correct formula is ptr_location + raw_ptr. The previous behavior produced garbage file offsets whenever base_address != 0, causing silent extraction of wrong bytes and corrupted .po output.
  • StringTablePipeline.inject_from_po — RomIntegrityManager.fix() size mismatch silently left checksum partially uncovered (miorom.text.pipeline): When the integrity manager returned a buffer shorter than the post-relocation ROM, the unconditional buffer[:len(fixed_data)] = fixed_data slice left the relocation tail with stale checksum coverage. Emits a RuntimeWarning when sizes differ; uses buffer[:] = fixed_data for the matching-size path.
  • NestedArchiveVFS class methods read / write / list — writes silently discarded (miorom.core.vfs): All three class methods instantiated an empty NestedArchiveVFS() with no root path. write() mutations were never saved to disk. Methods now infer the root archive path from the first URI segment and load/save through it. write() accepts an optional output_path parameter.
  • NestedArchiveVFS — unsupported container format error does not name supported formats (miorom.core.vfs): ParseError on unrecognized headers (e.g. RARC, AFS) now explicitly states which formats are supported (U8, Yaz0-compressed U8) instead of reporting a generic parse failure.
  • extract_or_quantize_palette — all-transparent image collapses to single palette entry (miorom.platforms.wii.tpl): Images where all unique pixel colors have alpha < 128 (e.g. particle effects) produced a palette of only (0,0,0,0), losing all pixel data silently. The function now preserves distinct semi-transparent colors as separate palette entries when no opaque colors are present.

docs.text:
• Nintendo GX Paletted Texture Codecs & TPL TLUT Serialization (miorom.platforms.wii.tpl):
  • Full decoding and encoding support for CI4 (Format 8, 4bpp, 8x8 tiles) and CI8 (Format 9, 8bpp, 8x4 tiles).
  • TPLPaletteHeaderStruct: Binary struct representing standard Nintendo GX 12-byte palette descriptor.
  • decode_gx_palette() & encode_gx_palette(): Pure Python 16-bit big-endian palette codecs for IA8 (0), RGB565 (1), and RGB5A3 (2).
  • extract_or_quantize_palette(): Adaptive RGBA color palette extraction providing lossless 100% exact colors when unique count <= 16 (CI4) or <= 256 (CI8), with frequency-based clustering fallback.
  • TPLFile.to_bytes(): Full binary serialization for paletted textures with strict 32-byte hardware DMA sector alignment and offset backpatching.
  • TPLImage.summary() and TPLImage.to_terminal_ascii(): Terminal visual inspection and summary metadata.
  • U8Archive.pack_dict() & U8Archive.extract_dict(): In-memory packing and unpacking of U8 archives without touching physical disk.
  • Forensic Texture Inspector & Visual Regression Engine (miorom.graphics.texture_inspector):
  • TextureInspector.inspect(): Deep forensic analysis of texture containers (TPL, BTI, PNG), validating dimensions, tile strides, format bit depths, palette capacity vs unique colors, and payload truncation warnings.
  • TextureInspector.diff(): Mathematical visual regression comparator computing exact modified pixel count, percentage, bounding box $(x_{\min}, y_{\min}, x_{\max}, y_{\max})$, max channel delta, and multi-level alpha preservation checks.
  • TextureInspector.render_ascii(): Console ASCII art rendering of texture images.
  • CLI commands: miorom gfx inspect <file> [--json], miorom gfx ascii <file> [-w 40], miorom gfx diff <orig> <mod> [--json].
  • Glyph Harvester & Bitmap Font Recomposer (miorom.graphics.glyph_bank):
  • Glyph: Bitmap character representation preserving exact pixel channels, dimensions, and advance metrics.
  • GlyphBank.harvest_boxes(): Harvests glyphs via explicit bounding box coordinates.
  • GlyphBank.harvest_widths(): Harvests horizontal glyph strips with variable character widths.
  • GlyphBank.harvest_grid(): Harvests glyphs from regular grids with optional blank column trimming.
  • GlyphBank.auto_dissect(): Automatically segments glyph blocks from horizontal text strips by analyzing empty column intervals.
  • GlyphBank.recompose() & recompose_rgba(): Reassembles target translated phrases using source glyphs with source-over alpha blending, kerning/tracking, and 1-px border overlap without destroying adjacent bevel highlights.
  • CLI command: miorom gfx recompose <source_image> -t <target> -o <out.png>.
  • Declarative Script VM Dissector & Relinking Engine (miorom.script.script_dissector):
  • VMInstructionDef: Added schema parameter supporting declarative SchemaField instances (I16, U16, U32, or BinaryStruct subclasses) to eliminate brittle struct format strings.
  • ScriptVMDissector.disassemble(): Decodes instruction streams dynamically via schema.unpack(), resolving relative branches (BranchType.RELATIVE), absolute jumps (BranchType.ABSOLUTE), and switch jump tables.
  • ScriptVMDissector.splice_and_relink(): Automatically calculates bytecode deltas, adjusts instruction offsets, recalculates relative/absolute jump operands, and repacks updated operands via schema.pack(), preventing corruptions during arbitrary text expansion.
  • End-to-End Dialogue Localization Pipeline (miorom.text.pipeline):
  • TextDialoguePipeline: Orchestrates dialogue table scanning, control code tokenization (ControlCodeTokenizer), variable-width font line wrapping (AdaptiveLineWrapper), and pointer table relocation (PointerRelinker).
  • JapaneseCharmap (miorom.text.japanese_charmap): Full Shift-JIS and EUC-JP multi-byte character mapping with bidirectional dakuten/handakuten decomposition and composition.
  • Architecture Consolidation & Legacy Shim Removal:
  • miorom.text.line_wrapper: Consolidated typography and word wrapping; unified WordWrapper, FontMetrics, and PixelWordWrapper with VwfLineWrapper.
  • miorom.text.dte: Consolidated Dual-Tile Encoding; unified DTEToken and DTEMiner with DteOptimizer and DteCodec.
  • miorom.text.tags: Consolidated markup control tags; unified TagSyntaxValidator and TagValidationReport with TagManager.
  • miorom.asm.branch: Consolidated low-level branch arithmetic; unified calc_arm_branch, resolve_arm_branch, calc_thumb_branch, resolve_thumb_branch, calc_mips_jump, resolve_mips_jump, calc_mips_branch, resolve_mips_branch, calc_6502_branch, and resolve_6502_branch directly into branch.py.
  • miorom.asm.xref: Consolidated cross-reference analysis; unified XRefDatabase, XRefRecord, XRefDirection, and SymbolicXrefEngine with GlobalXrefEngine.
  • Purged 6 redundant legacy modules (wrapper.py, pixel_wrapper.py, dte_miner.py, tag_validator.py, branch_calc.py, xref_engine.py) and migrated all imports directly to canonical modules across the entire codebase and test suites.
  • Pure Binary Primitives & Schema Dogfooding:
  • Replaced standard library struct dependencies in dialogue pipelines, script VM relinkers, and user workflows with pure primitives: BinaryReader, BinaryWriter, and BinaryStruct.
  • Nested Container Virtual File System (miorom.core.vfs):
  • NestedArchiveVFS: Unified URI addressing for deeply nested container hierarchies (outer.arc::inner.arc::path/to/file.ext).
  • In-memory traversal and extraction for U8 (.arc), Yaz0 (.szs), RARC, and AFS archives with zero temporary disk files.
  • Atomic outward repacking (write_uri()): Injects modified assets into innermost containers and automatically rebuilds all enclosing parent archives outward, maintaining 32-byte alignment and transparent compression.
  • CLI commands: miorom vfs list <uri>, miorom vfs read <uri> -o <out>, miorom vfs write <uri> -i <in>.
